title.en: Chinese vessel caught with banned shark fin in Pacific
title.zh: 中国渔船在太平洋被查获携带禁用鱼翅

summary.en: Kiribati, a small Pacific nation with growing ties to Beijing, detained a Chinese vessel this month for illegally harvesting shark fins, according to its maritime police. The practice of finning live sharks and discarding their bodies is banned in much of the Pacific but continues due to demand in Asia. The vessel was...
summary.zh: 据基里巴斯海事警察称，与北京关系日益密切的太平洋小国基里巴斯本月扣押了一艘中国渔船，因其非法捕捞鱼翅。将活鲨鱼割鳍并将其尸体丢弃的做法在太平洋大部分地区被禁止，但由于亚洲的需求而持续存在。该船是8月3日至14日期间由11个太平洋岛国进行的一次监视行动中扣押的四艘船只之一，美国海岸警卫队和一架澳大利亚军用飞机在部分地区提...

body.en: Kiribati, a tiny Pacific neighbour to Hawaii that has grown ties with Beijing, detained a Chinese vessel this month for illegally harvesting shark fins, its maritime police told AFP. Sharks. File photo: Klaus Stiefel/Flickr. The practice of cutting fins off live sharks and throwing the carcasses back into the sea is banned in much of the Pacific Ocean, but persists due to demand in East and Southeast Asia. The Chinese ship was among four vessels detained in a surveillance crackdown by 11 Pacific island nations between August 3 to 14, assisted by the US Coast Guard in some areas and an Australian military aircraft. Kiribati, however, operates its own patrol boat. The vessel was licensed to ply Kiribati’s waters but was detained by the maritime police after inspectors found shark fins on board, commander Tom Redfern told AFP. “It was escorted back to Christmas Island for further investigation,” he said, referring to a large atoll belonging to Kiribati and located south of Hawaii. Kiribati has an exclusive economic zone spanning 3.5 million square kilometres (1.4 million square miles) of ocean, and has drawn interest from Chinese state companies since switching diplomatic ties from Taiwan in 2019. A Kiribati flag. Photo: Kahunapule Michael Johnson/Flickr. It also hosts Chinese police, a decision the United States has said risks fuelling regional tensions. “A Kiribati Police maritime boarding officer, not under a shiprider agreement, boarded and inspected it, finding that the vessel was breaching its condition of licence by keeping and retaining shark fins onboard,” said Redfern. Kiribati has recently strengthened cooperation with France, with French military personnel due to arrive next month on Christmas Island to rebuild local police stations. The practice of removing shark fins is banned across the region. Andrew Chin, a fisheries researcher at Australia’s James Cook University, said finning had led to “massive declines” in shark numbers, prompting stringent controls in the Pacific. A bowl of shark fin soup. Photo: Janine Cheung/Flickr. “Because it is now illegal, if people are doing it, it is going to be hidden and really hard to detect,” he said. Research on the DNA of thousands of shark fins sold in Hong Kong markets pointed to its origins in the region. “We have seen evidence of illegal trade from the western and eastern sides of the Pacific,” Demian Chapman, who conducted the research as director of the Sharks and Rays Conservation Research Program at Mote Marine Laboratory in Florida, said. There have been other cases of Chinese vessels violating the finning ban, he told AFP. Reduced demand in China for shark fin soup, including a ban on serving it at government functions,...
body.zh: 基里巴斯是夏威夷的一个太平洋小邻国，与北京发展了关系，该国海警告诉法新社，该国本月扣押了一艘非法捕捞鱼翅的中国船只。鲨鱼。资料照片：Klaus Stiefel/Flickr。太平洋大部分地区禁止割下活鲨鱼鳍并将尸体扔回海中的做法，但由于东亚和东南亚的需求，这种做法仍然存在。 8月3日至14日，在美国海岸警卫队和一架澳大利亚军机的协助下，11个太平洋岛国在部分地区的监视行动中扣留了四艘中国船只，这艘中国船只就是其中之一。然而，基里巴斯拥有自己的巡逻艇。船长汤姆·雷德芬告诉法新社，该船获得在基里巴斯水域航行的许可，但在检查人员在船上发现鱼翅后被海警扣留。他说：“它被护送回圣诞岛进行进一步调查。”圣诞岛是属于基里巴斯、位于夏威夷南部的一个大型环礁。基里巴斯拥有占地 350 万平方公里（140 万平方英里）海洋的专属经济区，自 2019 年与台湾断交以来，吸引了中国国有企业的兴趣。一面基里巴斯国旗。照片：Kahunapule Michael Johnson/Flickr。它还驻有中国警察，美国称这一决定可能会加剧地区紧张局势。雷德芬说：“基里巴斯警方的一名海事登船官员在没有签订随船观察员协议的情况下登上并检查了该船，发现该船在船上保留鱼翅违反了许可证条件。”基里巴斯最近加强了与法国的合作，法国军事人员将于下个月抵达圣诞岛重建当地警察局。该地区禁止去除鱼翅的做法。澳大利亚詹姆斯库克大学渔业研究员安德鲁·钦表示，割鳍导致鲨鱼数量“大幅下降”，促使太平洋地区采取严格控制措施。一碗鱼翅汤。照片：Janine Cheung/Flickr。 “因为它现在是非法的，如果有人这样做，它就会被隐藏起来，很难被发现，”他说。对香港市场上出售的数千个鱼翅的 DNA 研究表明，其起源于该地区。 “我们已经看到了来自太平洋西侧和东侧非法贸易的证据，”佛罗里达州莫特海洋实验室鲨鱼和鳐鱼保护研究项目主任德米安·查普曼（Demian Chapman）表示。他告诉法新社，中国船只还发生过其他违反割鳍禁令的案件。中国对鱼翅汤的需求减少，包括禁止在政府职能中提供鱼翅汤，...

reflection.en: The illegal harvesting of shark fins, as seen with the detained Chinese vessel, represents a profound disregard for the natural world. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves,' a principle that extends beyond human beings to the vulnerable creatures and ecosystems that share our planet. May we be moved to advocate for...
reflection.zh: 被扣押的中国渔船所涉及的非法捕捞鱼翅行为，体现了对自然界的严重漠视。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口辩护”，这一原则不仅适用于人类，也适用于与我们共享地球的脆弱生物和生态系统。愿我们能被激励去为那些不能发声的生命代求，保护雅伟所创造的微妙生命平衡。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Chinese ambassador begins Australia posting, says took bus to work
title.zh: 中国大使开始澳大利亚任期，称乘公交车上班

summary.en: China's new ambassador to Australia, Liu Jinsong, began his posting by taking a public bus from Sydney to Canberra, during which he spoke with "ordinary Australians." He expressed honor and consciousness of his responsibility in his new role, aiming to improve relations between the two countries which had previously...
summary.zh: 中国新任驻澳大利亚大使刘劲松开始履新，他乘坐公共汽车从悉尼前往堪培拉，并在途中与“普通澳大利亚人”交谈。他表示对新职务感到荣幸并深感责任重大，旨在改善两国关系，此前两国关系曾跌至低谷。

body.en: Chinese ambassador Liu Jinsong said he had taken a public bus in Australia and spoke with “ordinary” people on his way to his new posting in the capital Canberra. China’s new ambassador to China Liu Jinsong. File photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP. Liu arrived in Australia on Monday, saying in a statement on the embassy website that he felt “both honoured and deeply conscious of the responsibility”. He said he had taken the bus from Sydney to Canberra, where he had chatted “with ordinary Australians on board, and thoroughly enjoyed the experience”. Relations between Beijing and Canberra reached a low point under former prime minister Scott Morrison, as China slapped import bans and restrictions on Australian commodities including coal, barley and wine. Several Australian moves had angered China, including legislation against overseas influence operations, barring tech giant Huawei from 5G contracts, and calling for an independent investigation into the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic. An Australia flag. File Photo: becca282bl/Pixabay. Ties have seen a marked improvement under Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, who has visited Beijing twice since taking office in 2022. But sources of tensions remain. Last month, Australia condemned China’s test of a nuclear-capable missile in the South Pacific, calling the launch “destabilising”. China remains the biggest customer for Australia’s iron ore, but Canberra has upped scrutiny of Chinese investment in the rare earths sector. Liu on Monday said “both sides should respect each other’s core interests and major concerns”. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese. Photo: Anthony Albanese, via Facebook. “Our two countries have no historical grievances, no fundamental conflict of interests, highly complementary economies and mutually enriching cultures”. Liu replaces Xiao Qian, an outspoken diplomat who often drew headlines in Australia for sometimes-fiery rhetoric defending the party line. Liu previously served as head of the foreign ministry’s Department of Asian Affairs, during which he held high-profile negotiations with Japanese officials as a diplomatic row erupted over Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s comments on Taiwan.
body.zh: 中国大使刘劲松表示，他在澳大利亚乘坐公共巴士，在前往首都堪培拉新任职务的途中与“普通”民众进行了交谈。中国新任驻华大使刘劲松。资料照片：佩德罗·帕尔多/法新社。刘先生于周一抵达澳大利亚，他在使馆网站上发表声明称，他感到“既荣幸又深感责任”。他说，他从悉尼乘坐巴士前往堪培拉，在那里他“与车上的普通澳大利亚人聊天，非常享受这次经历”。在前总理斯科特·莫里森 (Scott Morrison) 的领导下，随着中国对煤炭、大麦和葡萄酒等澳大利亚商品实施进口禁令和限制，北京和堪培拉之间的关系降到了低点。澳大利亚的几项举措激怒了中国，包括针对海外影响力行动的立法、禁止科技巨头华为参与5G合同，以及呼吁对Covid-19大流行的起源进行独立调查。澳大利亚国旗。文件照片：becca282bl/Pixabay。自 2022 年上任以来，两国关系已两次访问北京。但紧张局势的根源依然存在。上个月，澳大利亚谴责中国在南太平洋试射核导弹，称这次发射“破坏稳定”。中国仍然是澳大利亚铁矿石的最大客户，但堪培拉加强了对中国在稀土行业投资的审查。刘周一表示，“双方应尊重彼此的核心利益和重大关切”。澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯。照片：Anthony Albanese，来自 Facebook。 “我们两国没有历史恩怨，没有根本利害冲突，经济互补性强，文化相互丰富”。刘鹤接替了肖谦，肖谦是一位直言不讳的外交官，经常因捍卫党派路线的激烈言辞而成为澳大利亚的头条新闻。刘鹤此前担任外交部亚洲司司长，期间因日本首相高市早苗的台湾言论引发外交争端，期间他与日本官员举行了高调谈判。

reflection.en: Ambassador Liu Jinsong's choice to travel by public bus and engage with ordinary citizens on his way to Canberra signals a desire for connection and understanding. In a world often marked by division, such actions can be small but significant steps toward building bridges and fostering peace between nations.
reflection.zh: 刘劲松大使选择乘坐公共汽车并与普通民众交流，以此开始他在堪培拉的履新，这标志着他渴望建立联系和增进理解。在一个常常充满分歧的世界里，这样的举动虽然微小，却是建立桥梁和促进国家间和平的重要一步。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Six-company consortium wins Northern Metropolis tender for HK$1.03 billion
title.zh: 六公司联合体赢得北部都会区10.3亿港元招标

summary.en: A consortium of mainland Chinese firms and a local property company has been awarded a HK$1.03 billion tender for the first major land parcel to be developed as part of the Northern Metropolis mega project. However, the fact that the consortium will operate only one of the three tech parks on the plot, with the...
summary.zh: 一个由中国内地公司和一家本地地产公司组成的联合体赢得了北部都会区大型项目首块土地的开发权，中标金额为10.3亿港元。然而，该联合体仅负责该地块上三个科技园中的一个，其余由政府监管，这可能表明市场对该基础设施项目投资“持谨慎态度”，一位前议员表示。这六家企业，包括国有和私营公司，预计将在洪水桥/厦村新发展区投资约168亿...

body.en: A consortium of mainland Chinese firms and a local property company has been awarded a HK$1.03 billion tender for the first major land parcel to be developed as part of the Northern Metropolis mega project in the northern New Territories. Hung Shui Kiu. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. However, the fact that the consortium will operate only one of the three tech parks on the plot, with the government to oversee the others, may indicate that the market remains “cautious” about investing in the infrastructure project, a former lawmaker said . The six enterprises, consisting of both state-owned and private firms, have projected an investment of about HK$16.8 billion in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area, which is expected to create 6,000 jobs and provide 3,000 residential flats, according to a Monday statement . The six-company joint venture, HSK New Development, comprises subsidiaries of China Overseas Land & Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land (Overseas), China Tourism Group, and e-commerce giant JD.com, as well as Hong Kong developer Sino Land. The 11-hectare Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen site is the first “large-scale land disposal” in the Northern Metropolis to be tendered. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said in the Monday statement that the plot “is a project of considerable scale with a long investment period.” “The consortium of successful tenderers encompasses not only major enterprises that have long participated in local real estate development, but also market leaders that are well-established in other industries with undeniable experience and capability,” Linn said. Hong Kong’s border areas near Shenzhen is set to be transformed into a 30,000-hectare Northern Metropolis. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The firms had pooled their strengths to “cast a vote of confidence” in the Northern Metropolis, she said. The Northern Metropolis is a sprawling infrastructure project set to transform 30,000 hectares of land in rural Hong Kong near the border with mainland China into a tech hub, providing more homes and deepening the city’s integration with neighbouring Shenzhen. The government adopted a “two-envelope” system when assessing the tenders, with a 30 per cent weighting for bids’ monetary value and 70 per cent for non-monetary benefits such as creating jobs and bringing in high-quality enterprises. Remaining cautious The joint venture will be responsible for developing three residential sites that can yield about 3,000 flats, as well as an Enterprise and Technology Park. They will be granted to the consortium on 50-year leases. The consortium will also build a large-scale modern logistics hub within the park, with e-commerce titan JD.com positioned as the anchor tenant. Hung Shui Kiu in Hong Kong. File...
body.zh: 由中国内地企业和一家本地房地产公司组成的财团已中标价值 10.3 亿港元的标书，竞标新界北部北部都会大型项目的第一块主要地块。洪水桥。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。然而，一位前立法者表示，该财团将仅运营该地块上三个科技园区中的一个，而政府负责监督其他园区，这一事实可能表明市场对投资该基础设施项目仍然“谨慎”。根据周一的一份声明，这六家国有和私营企业预计在洪水桥/厦村新发展区投资约168亿港元，预计将创造6,000个就业机会并提供3,000个住宅单位。这家由六家公司组成的合资企业HSK New Development由中国海外发展、招商局置地、华润置地（海外）、中国旅游集团、电子商务巨头京东以及香港开发商信和置业的子公司组成。洪水桥/厦村用地占地11公顷，是北区首个进行招标的“大规模土地处置”。发展局局长伯纳黛特·林恩在周一的声明中表示，该地块“是一个规模相当大、投资周期长的项目”。林恩表示：“中标的财团不仅包括长期参与当地房地产开发的大型企业，还包括在其他行业拥有丰富经验和能力的市场领导者。”香港靠近深圳的边境地区将被改造成占地3万公顷的北方都会区。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。她说，这些公司汇集了各自的优势，为这座北方大都市“投下了信任票”。北方都市是一个庞大的基础设施项目，旨在将香港与中国大陆边境附近的农村地区 30,000 公顷土地改造成科技中心，提供更多住房，并加深该市与邻近深圳的融合。政府在评标时采用“双信封”制度，投标货币价值权重为30%，创造就业、引进优质企业等非货币效益权重为70%。保持谨慎 该合资企业将负责开发三块住宅用地，可提供约3,000套公寓，以及一个企业和科技园。它们将以 50 年的租约授予该财团。该联盟还将在园区内建设一个大型现代物流中心，电子商务巨头京东将作为主要租户。香港洪水桥。文件...

reflection.en: This news highlights a significant investment in a large-scale development project, involving multiple companies and substantial capital. It reflects the human endeavor to build and develop, often accompanied by careful planning and hope for future prosperity. As these ventures unfold, the ancient wisdom reminds us to entrust our plans and efforts to a...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻报道了一个大型开发项目的重大投资，涉及多家公司和巨额资金。它反映了人类建设和发展的努力，通常伴随着审慎的规划和对未来繁荣的希望。当这些事业展开时，古老的智慧提醒我们，要将我们的计划和努力托付给更高的力量，在所有大小事务中寻求指引和祝福。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Woman arrested for alleged sedition outside court ahead of Tiananmen vigil group’s national security case verdict
title.zh: 香港女子在天安门纪念团体国安案判决前被控煽动罪名逮捕

summary.en: Hong Kong police arrested a woman on Friday for alleged sedition outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building, just hours before leaders of a Tiananmen vigil group were convicted under the national security law. The 45-year-old woman was detained on suspicion of seditious intent, public disorder, and obstructing...
summary.zh: 香港警方周五在西九龙法院大楼外逮捕了一名女子，指控其涉嫌煽动罪，此前不久，一个天安门纪念团体的一批领导人被判犯有危害国家安全罪。这名45岁的女子因涉嫌煽动意图、扰乱公共秩序和阻碍警方而被拘留。

body.en: Hong Kong police arrested a woman for alleged sedition outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, hours before leaders of a Tiananmen vigil group were found guilty under the national security law . Hong Kong police set up a cordon outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on August 21, 2026, ahead of the verdict hearing of the trial of two Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tang and Lee Cheuk-yan on national security charges. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police told local media outlets that a 45-year-old was arrested early on Friday on suspicion of acting with seditious intention, disorder in public places, and obstructing police. She was detained for investigation. According to The Collective, the woman was among those queueing for seats in the public gallery for the verdict for Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan. The two are former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, which used to organise Hong Kong’s annual Tiananmen vigils. See also: Conviction of Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists draws approval from gov’t, concern from overseas human rights groups The organisation itself, which announced its disbandment in September 2021, was also on trial. The Tiananmen vigil in Victoria Park on June 4, 2018. File photo: Etan Liam, via Flickr. Both the two activists and the Alliance were accused of inciting subversion through calls for “ending one-party rule” – a slogan that prosecutors said amounted to calling for the overthrow of the Chinese Communist Party. The woman was taken into a police vehicle at around 5am, according to The Collective. A witness who was also in the queue told the media outlet that the woman was wearing a black t-shirt with Japanese characters. HKFP has reached out to the police for comment. Acting with seditious intention is an offence under Article 23, the city’s local security law. It is punishable by up to seven years’ imprisonment, or 10 years if the offence is committed with foreign forces. The Alliance case was adjourned to Friday for mitigation statements.
body.zh: 周五，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外逮捕了一名涉嫌煽动叛乱的妇女，几个小时后，天安门守夜组织的领导人根据国家安全法被判有罪。 2026 年 8 月 21 日，在两名天安门守夜活动人士周行棠和李卓人因国家安全罪名受审的判决听证会之前，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外设置了警戒线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方告诉当地媒体，一名 45 岁的男子于周五早些时候被捕，罪名是涉嫌煽动叛乱、扰乱公共场所秩序以及妨碍警察执法。她被拘留接受调查。据《The Collective》报道，这名女子是在旁听席上排队等待周恒东和李卓人判决的人之一。两人是香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟的前领导人，该联盟曾组织香港一年一度的天安门守夜活动。另请参阅：对香港天安门守夜活动人士的定罪获得政府批准、海外人权组织的关注 该组织本身也在接受审判，该组织于 2021 年 9 月宣布解散。 2018 年 6 月 4 日，维多利亚公园举行的天安门守夜活动。资料照片：Etan Liam，来自 Flickr。这两名活动人士和联盟都被指控通过呼吁“结束一党统治”煽动颠覆——检察官称这一口号相当于呼吁推翻中国共产党。据 The Collective 报道，该女子于凌晨 5 点左右被带上警车。一名也在排队的目击者告诉媒体，这名女子穿着一件印有日文的黑色T恤。 HKFP已联系警方置评。根据该市当地安全法第 23 条，具有煽动意图的行为属于犯罪行为。如果是外国军队所为，最高可判处 7 年监禁，如果是与外国军队共同犯罪，则可判处 10 年监禁。联盟案件推迟至周五发表缓解声明。

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, a woman was arrested for alleged sedition on the same day leaders of a Tiananmen vigil group were found guilty under the national security law. This situation brings to mind the apostles' declaration: "We must obey God rather than human beings." It prompts reflection on the difficult balance between civic duty and adherence to one's...
reflection.zh: 在香港，一名女子在天安门纪念团体领导人根据国安法被判有罪的同一天，因涉嫌煽动罪被捕。这一情况令人想起使徒们的宣告：“我们必须服从雅伟，而不是人。”这促使人们反思公民责任与遵循良心之间的艰难平衡，尤其是在法律似乎与根深蒂固的信仰相冲突时。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...

title.en: Large mammals alter soil chemistry and increase fertility in the Atlantic Forest
title.zh: 大型哺乳动物改变土壤化学并增加大西洋森林的肥力

summary.en: A study published in the journal Ecological Monographs indicates that large mammals, such as tapirs, peccaries, agoutis and deer, alter the chemical composition of litter and soil in tropical forests of the Brazilian Atlantic Forest. As a result, they increase nutrient...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A study published in the journal Ecological Monographs indicates that large mammals, such as tapirs, peccaries, agoutis and deer, alter the chemical composition of litter and soil in tropical forests of the Brazilian Atlantic Forest. As a result, they increase nutrient availability and, possibly, soil fertility.

The study was conducted by members of the Center for Research on Biodiversity and Climate Change (CBioClima), a Research, Innovation and Dissemination Center (RIDC) based at the Institute of Biosciences of São Paulo State University (IB-UNESP) in Rio Claro.

The findings underscore the critical role of these animals, which are heavily targeted by poachers and experiencing population decline, in the long-term survival of the biome, even within areas where forest cover remains intact.

"Most of the mammalian biomass in contiguous areas of the Atlantic Forest consists of peccaries, native wild pigs that live in herds that can exceed 100 individuals," says Letícia Gonçalves Ribeiro, the lead author of the study. Ribeiro conducted the research as part of her Ph.D. at IB-UNESP.

"They arrive in an area and spend a lot of time trampling and rooting around in the ground, searching for fallen fruits and seeds, as well as defecating and urinating. As a result, they end up influencing nutrient cycling, altering soil chemistry and the diversity of the litter—the layer of leaves, twigs and fruits on the soil surface," the scientist explains. Other large herbivorous mammals that inhabit the biome include tapirs, deer, and agoutis.

To better understand the importance of these animals to the Atlantic Forest ecosystem, the researchers compared soil and litter samples from areas where the mammals roam freely with samples from fenced-off areas where they were temporarily eliminated.

The results revealed substantial differences in acidity (pH)—less acidic with animals present and more acidic without—as well as in the availability of nutrients, such as calcium and aluminum.

"Aluminum, which is harmful to plants at high levels, was reduced where there was a greater presence of animals. This nutrient has a special relationship with pH and calcium. A balance between the two is necessary for greater soil fertility," says Ribeiro. In practice, this means that the presence of large mammals increases forest soil fertility.

In areas with mammals, a reduction in lignin was observed in the leaf litter. Lignin is a complex molecule that coats plant cells and hinders their decomposition. When stirred up and trampled by animals, leaf litter becomes more evenly distributed and breaks down...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 发表在《生态专着》杂志上的一项研究表明，大型哺乳动物，如貘、西貒、刺豚鼠和鹿，改变了巴西大西洋森林热带森林中的垃圾和土壤的化学成分。因此，它们可以增加养分的利用率，并可能提高土壤的肥力。 该研究由生物多样性和气候变化研究中心 (CBioClima) 的成员进行，该中心是位于里奥克拉罗圣保罗州立大学生物科学研究所 (IB-UNESP) 的研究、创新和传播中心 (RIDC)。 这些发现强调了这些动物在生物群落的长期生存中发挥的关键作用，即使在森林覆盖完好的地区，这些动物也是偷猎者的重点目标，并且数量正在减少。 该研究的主要作者莱蒂西亚·贡萨尔维斯·里贝罗 (Letícia Gonçalves Ribeiro) 表示：“大西洋森林邻近地区的大部分哺乳动物生物量都是西貒，这是一种本地野猪，它们的猪群数量可能超过 100 头。”里贝罗进行了这项研究，作为她博士学位的一部分。在IB-UNESP。 这位科学家解释说：“它们到达一个地区后，会花大量时间在地面上践踏和探根，寻找掉落的水果和种子，以及排便和排尿。结果，它们最终影响了养分循环，改变了土壤化学和凋落物的多样性——土壤表面的树叶、树枝和水果层。”栖息在该生物群系的其他大型草食哺乳动物包括貘、鹿和刺豚鼠。 为了更好地了解这些动物对大西洋森林生态系统的重要性，研究人员将哺乳动物自由漫步地区的土壤和垃圾样本与它们暂时被消灭的围栏地区的样本进行了比较。 结果显示，酸度 (pH) 存在显着差异（有动物存在时酸性较低，无动物存在时酸性较高），以及钙和铝等营养物质的可用性也存在显着差异。 “铝含量高时对植物有害，但在动物较多的地方含量会减少。这种营养物质与 pH 值和钙有特殊关系。两者之间的平衡对于提高土壤肥力是必要的，”Ribeiro 说。实际上，这意味着大型哺乳动物的存在增加了森林土壤的肥力。 在有哺乳动物的地区，在落叶中观察到木质素减少。木质素是一种复杂的分子，覆盖植物细胞并阻碍其分解。当被动物搅动和践踏时，落叶变得更加均匀并分解......

title.en: The little red dots of our cosmos might hide something big
title.zh: 我们宇宙中的小红点可能隐藏着一些大东西

summary.en: Little red dots may reside in small, dense galaxies with total masses equivalent to around 1 billion times that of the sun, according to research published in Nature Astronomy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Little red dots may reside in small, dense galaxies with total masses equivalent to around 1 billion times that of the sun, according to research published in Nature Astronomy .

The findings offer new clues about how these mysterious objects developed within the first billion years after the Big Bang.

Little red dots are small, red objects seen at great distances from Earth. However, the nature of little red dots and the source of their light remain unclear. Previous research has found signs of material around some of these objects at ultraviolet wavelengths, possibly indicating the presence of galaxies. However, there has been little evidence of this material in optical light (light that human eyes can see), which gives a clearer view of stellar mass.

Xuheng Ding, Lilan Yang and colleagues combined James Webb Space Telescope images of 217 little red dots to reveal faint optical emission—light extending beyond the central objects—that could not be clearly detected in individual images. Modeling of the data indicates that this emission likely comes from star-forming galaxies , with little red dots residing at their centers as supermassive black holes.

The galaxies have average radii of just 210 parsecs (about 685 light-years), making them about 2.5 times more compact than other star-forming galaxies of a similar mass seen at a comparable period in the universe's history.

The findings suggest that little red dots are not simply single points of light but likely exist within compact star-forming galaxies, which helps explain their origin. However, the authors note that the results describe the average properties of the full sample, as the extended emission is too faint to be detected around most individual objects.

Further work is needed to confirm the sample spectroscopically by analyzing the objects' light to verify their distances.

Yiyang Zhang et al, Extended components of little red dots in the rest-frame optical, Nature Astronomy (2026). DOI: 10.1038/s41550-026-02945-z

Swati Mestri holds a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering and has worked as a content editor since 2019. She has experience editing research documents across technology, health care, and materials science, and has a particular interest in technology and space. Full profile →

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success. Full profile →
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 根据《自然天文学》发表的研究，小红点可能存在于小而稠密的星系中，其总质量约为太阳的 10 亿倍。 这些发现为了解这些神秘物体在大爆炸后最初十亿年内如何发展提供了新线索。 小红点是在距地球很远的地方看到的红色小物体。然而，小红点的性质及其光源仍不清楚。先前的研究已经在其中一些物体周围发现了紫外线波长的物质迹象，这可能表明星系的存在。然而，在可见光（人眼可以看到的光）中几乎没有证据表明这种物质，这可以更清晰地观察恒星质量。 Xuheng Ding、Lilan Yang 及其同事将詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜拍摄的 217 个小红点图像组合在一起，揭示了微弱的光发射（延伸到中心物体之外的光），这种光发射在单个图像中无法清晰检测到。数据建模表明，这种发射可能来自恒星形成星系，其中心有一些小红点，是超大质量黑洞。 这些星系的平均半径仅为 210 秒差距（约 685 光年），这使得它们比在宇宙历史相当时期看到的具有类似质量的其他恒星形成星系紧凑约 2.5 倍。 研究结果表明，小红点不仅仅是单点光点，而且很可能存在于致密的恒星形成星系中，这有助于解释它们的起源。然而，作者指出，结果描述了整个样本的平均特性，因为扩展发射太微弱，无法在大多数单个物体周围检测到。 需要进一步的工作，通过分析物体的光来验证它们的距离，从而通过光谱来确认样本。 张一阳等人，静止框架光学中小红点的扩展成分，自然天文学（2026）。 DOI：10.1038/s41550-026-02945-z Swati Mestri 拥有电子工程学士学位，自 2019 年以来一直担任内容编辑。她拥有编辑技术、医疗保健和材料科学领域研究文档的经验，并且对技术和空间特别感兴趣。完整档案 → 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

summary.en: What did ordinary people really eat in premodern Japan, beyond the dishes described in cookbooks and the bones discarded at urban waste pits? Reconstructing past diets at the level of individual food items is remarkably difficult. Traditional archaeological approaches and stable...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: What did ordinary people really eat in premodern Japan, beyond the dishes described in cookbooks and the bones discarded at urban waste pits? Reconstructing past diets at the level of individual food items is remarkably difficult. Traditional archaeological approaches and stable isotope analysis of human skeletons reveal broad dietary categories—such as reliance on marine fish and C3 plants. But they cannot show which specific taxa or tissues each person consumed, nor how access differed among social groups in a stratified society like premodern Japan.
body.zh: 在前现代的日本，除了食谱中描述的菜肴和城市垃圾坑里丢弃的骨头之外，普通人到底吃什么？在单个食品的层面上重建过去的饮食是非常困难的。传统的考古方法和人体骨骼的稳定同位素分析揭示了广泛的饮食类别，例如对海鱼和 C3 植物的依赖。但它们无法显示每个人消耗哪些特定的分类群或组织，也无法显示在像前现代日本这样的分层社会中，社会群体之间的获取方式有何不同。

title.en: Can AI replace traditional language learning? A new study says not yet
title.zh: AI能否取代传统语言学习？一项新研究称还没有

summary.en: When university students set out to learn English as an additional language, it's not just about internalizing a new list of words; they also have to learn common word combinations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When university students set out to learn English as an additional language, it's not just about internalizing a new list of words; they also have to learn common word combinations.

To sound fluent and natural, they'll need to say "strong wind" but not "muscular wind," or "reach a conclusion" but not "pull a conclusion"—a task that's particularly challenging for learners stepping into terminology-heavy academic fields from economics to engineering.

So what's the best way to learn those invaluable combinations, also known as collocations? According to a new paper from the UBC Sauder School of Business, data-driven learning, with a little boost from AI, is still the most reliable option.

The findings are published in the journal Nouvelles perspectives en sciences sociales .

According to UBC Sauder lecturer Dr. Déogratias (Deo) Nizonkiza, the author of the study, the development of corpora—large, structured collections of texts and other language data—has been foundational for DDL approaches. It has happened in three major stages.

In 1961, a collection of texts called the Brown Corpus was developed at Brown University. It comprised 500 text samples from media, religion, fiction, science and other sources, each containing approximately 2,000 words. With roughly 1 million words, it represented the first large-scale collection of real-world American English, and it allowed researchers to effectively catalog and analyze the language and its use.

In the 1980s, as technology advanced and computing became more widely available, the concept of data-driven learning, or DDL, was introduced. Instead of memorizing phrases from textbooks, learners could access increasingly massive databases of texts—with word counts eventually exceeding 100 million—to discover everyday language patterns.

In 2008 came the Corpus of Contemporary American English, or COCA—a 1 billion-word database that comprises nearly 500,000 texts from 1990 to 2019 and allows students not only to search for specific words but also to look for examples in different contexts and academic disciplines.

"That really significantly changed how we do things, specifically in the area of English for academic or professional purposes," Nizonkiza explains. "But the searches took so much time, and people would get discouraged."

In addition to the sluggish searches, another stumbling block was that many language instructors didn't even know the corpora existed, let alone how to use them, and those who did often treated DDL as a secondary activity—not a core teaching tool.

Now, with the advent of generative AI, or GenAI,...

title.en: AI helps workers most when paired with experience, new study finds
title.zh: 新研究发现，人工智能与经验结合时对工人的帮助最大

summary.en: As companies race to integrate artificial intelligence into the workplace, new research suggests workers benefit most when AI is paired with experience rather than treated as a replacement for it.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As companies race to integrate artificial intelligence into the workplace, new research suggests workers benefit most when AI is paired with experience rather than treated as a replacement for it.

The study, "Human-Algorithm Collaboration in Gig Work: The Role of Experience, Skill Level, and Task Complexity," published in Information Systems Research , found that AI-powered guidance improved productivity, service quality and operational flexibility among Instacart shoppers. The researchers also found that worker experience played a critical role in determining who benefited most from the technology.

Researchers conducted a randomized controlled field experiment involving nearly 6,000 Instacart shoppers across approximately 160 grocery stores in the United States. Participants were randomly assigned to receive AI-powered navigation and product-location recommendations while completing customer orders, allowing researchers to measure the technology's impact under real-world working conditions.

The researchers also found that experience influenced how effectively workers used the technology.

Less experienced shoppers relied more heavily on the AI system but did not consistently achieve better outcomes. More experienced workers were better able to combine AI recommendations with their own judgment, particularly during more complex shopping trips and periods of heavier workload.

"There's a growing assumption that AI levels the playing field by making expertise less important," said study author Benjamin Knight, a researcher at Maplebear Inc.

"Our findings suggest something different. AI is most effective when workers have enough experience to understand when to trust its recommendations and when to rely on their own judgment."

The findings suggest organizations may realize greater value from workplace AI by pairing technological investments with employee development and training.

"Organizations often focus on deploying better AI," said Dmitry Mitrofanov, co-author of the study and assistant professor of operations management at Boston College. "Our findings suggest they should place equal emphasis on developing workers who know how to use it effectively. Technology and human experience work best together."

The implications extend beyond grocery delivery. Companies across retail, logistics, health care, customer service and other industries are increasingly deploying AI tools to support frontline workers. The study suggests the greatest benefits may come when those tools complement human expertise rather than attempt to replace it.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 随着公司竞相将人工智能融入工作场所，新的研究表明，当人工智能与经验相结合而不是被视为经验的替代品时，员工受益最多。 这项研究《零工工作中的人机协作：经验、技能水平和任务复杂性的作用》发表在《信息系统研究》上，发现人工智能驱动的指导提高了 Instacart 购物者的生产力、服务质量和操作灵活性。研究人员还发现，工人的经验在决定谁从该技术中受益最多方面发挥着关键作用。 研究人员进行了一项随机对照现场实验，涉及美国约 160 家杂货店的近 6,000 名 Instacart 购物者。参与者被随机分配接受人工智能驱动的导航和产品定位建议，同时完成客户订单，从而使研究人员能够衡量该技术在现实工作条件下的影响。 研究人员还发现，经验会影响员工使用该技术的效率。 经验不足的购物者更依赖人工智能系统，但并没有始终如一地取得更好的结果。经验丰富的员工能够更好地将人工智能建议与自己的判断结合起来，特别是在更复杂的购物行程和工作量更大的时期。 “越来越多的人认为，人工智能通过降低专业知识的重要性来创造公平的竞争环境，”该研究的作者、Maplebear Inc. 的研究员本杰明·奈特 (Benjamin Knight) 说。 “我们的研究结果表明了一些不同的东西。当员工有足够的经验来了解何时信任其建议以及何时依赖自己的判断时，人工智能是最有效的。” 研究结果表明，通过将技术投资与员工发展和培训相结合，组织可以从工作场所人工智能中实现更大的价值。 该研究的合著者、波士顿学院运营管理助理教授德米特里·米特罗法诺夫 (Dmitry Mitrofanov) 表示：“组织通常专注于部署更好的人工智能。” “我们的研究结果表明，他们应该同等重视培养懂得如何有效利用技术的员工。技术和人类经验相结合效果最佳。” 其影响不仅仅限于杂货配送。零售、物流、医疗保健、客户服务和其他行业的公司越来越多地部署人工智能工具来支持一线员工。该研究表明，当这些工具补充而不是试图取代人类专业知识时，可能会带来最大的好处。 “人工智能具有巨大的潜力......

title.en: Setting limits on phase transitions in the dark energy era
title.zh: 对暗能量时代的相变设定限制

summary.en: The universe is known to be expanding at an accelerating rate. Physicists typically attribute this acceleration to dark energy, a mysterious component of the universe that exerts negative pressure, causing space to expand faster. Dark energy is thought to have become the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The universe is known to be expanding at an accelerating rate. Physicists typically attribute this acceleration to dark energy, a mysterious component of the universe that exerts negative pressure, causing space to expand faster. Dark energy is thought to have become the predominant influence on the universe's evolution around 3–4 billion years ago, at the beginning of what is known as the dark energy era.

Researchers at the University of Notre Dame and Fudan University recently showed that fluctuations in the cosmic microwave background (CMB), small variations in the radiation left over from the Big Bang, could be used to probe phase transitions during the dark energy era.

Using this theoretical approach, outlined in a paper published in Physical Review Letters , Seth Koren, Yuhsin Tsai and Runqing Wang examined a hypothetical first-order phase transition (FOPT) occurring after dark energy became predominant and placed limits on how much vacuum energy it could have released. A FOPT is a sudden change from one physical state to another that unfolds through the formation of bubbles and releases energy.

"As we continue to find null results on interactions of dark sector particles with Standard Model particles—including, importantly, dark matter—we must take more seriously the possibility that these sectors may only interact with us gravitationally," Koren told Phys.org.

"This 'nightmare case' is harder to probe, but it doesn't mean the dark sector is invisible. Our best hope is to look for the cosmological footprint of the dynamics of dark sectors, where the gravitational coupling with our sector may result in observable effects on our particles."

In its early history, the universe underwent profound changes, including the electroweak and quantum chromodynamics (QCD) phase transitions. The researchers considered whether a hidden part of the universe could have undergone a similar phase transition more recently.

"This is a good place to start testing how well we can see purely gravitational dark sector effects," said Koren.

"While science fiction often portrays vacuum decay as an instantaneous, apocalyptic catastrophe, our work highlights that a phase transition in a secluded dark sector would be a silent cosmic event, entirely imperceptible in our daily lives. To observe or constrain such an event, we must carefully look at precise cosmological measurements to check for subtle changes in the spectrum of photons from the CMB."

title.en: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
title.zh: 龙卷风席卷法国村庄，数十人受伤，房屋被毁

summary.en: A tornado struck the village of Pomas in southwestern France, causing widespread damage to hundreds of homes and injuring 39 people, with 15 requiring hospitalization.
summary.zh: 一场龙卷风袭击了法国西南部的波马斯村，摧毁了数百所房屋，造成39人受伤，其中15人被送往医院。

body.en:
A tornado has torn through the village of Pomas in south-west France, injuring 39 people and damaging hundreds of homes.

Authorities said 15 people were taken to hospital and two were in a critical condition. One man said his pregnant wife was injured after their house collapsed on her.

More than 120 emergency workers were deployed to the village south of Carcassonne after winds reaching 117km/h (73mph) tore roofs off houses and damaged an estimated 300 homes on Monday.

"Half the village has been destroyed," said one resident called Pierre, who described the tornado as swirling like a "huge red and yellow chimney".

"There's a huge castle and a third of it is has collapsed - even though these are stones that have stood for 1,000 years," Pierre told Ici Occitanie.

The third stage of the Vuelta a España cycle race, which was taking place in the Aude area of south-western France, had to be cancelled when a hail storm forced the riders to take shelter about 15km from the finish line.

The extreme weather has left about 2,800 homes across 10 villages without electricity, according to officials.

Local sub-prefect Emmanuelle Plantier-Lemarchand told French radio that she was not aware of anyone missing. She lowered the number of victims from 41 to 39, and said 15 of them had been treated in hospital.

"I heard this massive noise... then I saw everything flying around in the air and my roof collapsed over my head," shocked resident Chantal told French radio. "I've got no house left, that's for sure... I was really scared. I thought that's it, this my final hour."

French authorities had issued an orange alert for thunderstorms in large parts of the country's south-west, which have already been hit by power outages and transport disruptions.

Eyewitness footage from the region captured the swirling vortex of the tornado looming in the horizon above houses and trees.

Images from the small village of Pomas, which was the hardest hit, showed uprooted trees, damaged cars and rubble from destroyed homes.

Meanwhile there were flight delays and cancellations at airports in Bordeaux, Marseille, Nice, Toulouse and north of Paris to the north, said Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot.

On average, France experiences several dozen tornadoes per year, according to the country's national weather service Météo-France.

It comes after Europe's summer of unprecedented heatwaves and wildfires, with France's south-west region among the worst affected with an area of 42,000 hectares burnt in one of the largest forest fires since World War Two.
body.zh: 一场龙卷风席卷了法国西南部的波马斯村，造成 39 人受伤，数百所房屋受损。 当局表示，15 人被送往医院，其中两人情况危急。一名男子说，他怀孕的妻子在房子倒塌后受伤。 周一，时速 117 公里（73 英里）的大风掀翻了房屋屋顶，估计有 300 所房屋受损，超过 120 名紧急救援人员被部署到卡尔卡松以南的村庄。 “半个村庄已被摧毁，”一位名叫皮埃尔的居民说，他形容龙卷风像“巨大的红黄色烟囱”一样旋转。 “有一座巨大的城堡，尽管这些石头已经屹立了 1000 年，但它的三分之一已经倒塌了，”皮埃尔告诉 Ici Occitanie。 环西班牙自行车赛第三赛段在法国西南部奥德地区举行，由于冰雹迫使车手们在距终点线约 15 公里处避难，比赛不得不取消。 据官员称，极端天气导致 10 个村庄约 2,800 户家庭断电。 当地副省长埃曼纽尔·普朗蒂埃·勒马尔尚 (Emmanuelle Plantier-Lemarchan) 告诉法国电台，她不知道有人失踪。她将受害者人数从 41 人减少到 39 人，并表示其中 15 人已在医院接受治疗。 震惊的居民尚塔尔告诉法国电台：“我听到巨大的噪音……然后我看到一切都在空中飞舞，我的屋顶倒塌了。” “我已经没有房子了，这是肯定的。” 法国当局已对该国西南部大部分地区发布雷暴橙色警报，这些地区已经遭受停电和交通中断的影响。 该地区的目击者镜头捕捉到龙卷风的漩涡在房屋和树木上方的地平线上若隐若现。 来自受灾最严重的波马斯小村庄的图像显示，树木被连根拔起，汽车受损，房屋被毁，瓦砾遍地。 与此同时，交通部长菲利普·塔巴罗特表示，波尔多、马赛、尼斯、图卢兹以及巴黎北部的机场都出现了航班延误和取消。 据法国国家气象局称，法国平均每年会经历数十次龙卷风。 此前，欧洲夏季遭遇了前所未有的热浪和野火，法国西南部地区是受影响最严重的地区，面积达 42,000 公顷，是第二次世界大战以来最大规模的森林火灾之一。

The Apostle Paul writes that all of creation groans, awaiting redemption from decay and destruction. In moments of natural disaster, we witness this groaning firsthand, a shared suffering that calls for compassion and hope in God's ultimate...
reflection.zh: 法国波马斯村遭受龙卷风袭击的毁灭性力量，提醒我们世界的脆弱。使徒保罗写道，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦，直到如今，等待着救赎脱离败坏的辖制。在自然灾害的时刻，我们亲眼目睹了这种叹息，一种共同的苦难，呼唤着怜悯和对上帝最终复兴的盼望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Moon set to turn red as rare partial lunar eclipse graces UK skies
title.zh: 罕见的月偏食照亮英国天空，月亮将变成红色

summary.en: There will be a partial lunar eclipse in the UK on 28 August, and may cause the Moon appear reddish in colour.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Skywatchers across the UK could have the chance to see a stunning partial lunar eclipse later this week as the Sun, Earth, and Moon line up in the night sky.

Lunar eclipses occur when the Moon is full which will take place in the early hours of 28 August. It may cause the full Moon - nicknamed the Sturgeon Moon - to take on an eerie reddish glow.

It comes just weeks after the UK experienced its most dramatic partial solar eclipse in nearly 30 years.

Adding to the spectacle, its position in the sky will be low on the horizon, causing a phenomenon known as the Moon illusion. This makes the Moon appear bigger and more dramatic than usual.

The partial eclipse will begin at 03:33 BST in London, when the Moon enters Earth's darkest shadow.

It will reach its maximum at 05:12 BST, when around 90% of the Moon will be within the umbra.

By this point the Moon will be very low in the south-western sky, causing something known as the Moon illusion .

This is a term for when the Moon appears much larger than it is based on its position in the sky - an effect caused by the way our brains process visual information.

The effect is particularly noticeable during a moonrise or moonset, when the lunar disc is seen alongside familiar objects on the ground.

A lunar eclipse happens when the Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon, causing the Moon to temporarily move into the Earth's shadow.

During a partial eclipse, only part of the Moon enters the darkest section of that shadow, known as the umbra.

Sunlight passing through the Earth's atmosphere is scattered, with shorter blue wavelengths scattering more easily, while more of the longer wavelength red light reach the Moon.

These wavelengths are then reflected back towards Earth, giving the eclipsed Moon its reddish colour.

For the best chance of seeing the eclipse, astronomers recommend finding a high location with an unobstructed view towards the south-western horizon.

Viewing conditions are expected to vary considerably across the UK during the early hours of Friday morning.

With low pressure in charge, cloud and heavy showers are likely to affect some parts of the country, while other areas remain clear.

Currently, the best viewing conditions are expected across central and eastern parts of England and Wales. However, even here, the cloud cover could change a lot from one hour to the next and is very hard to forecast accurately.

You can check the latest hour-by-hour forecast where you are online or via the BBC Weather app.
body.zh: 本周晚些时候，当太阳、地球和月亮在夜空中排成一行时，英国各地的天文爱好者可能有机会看到令人惊叹的月偏食。 月食发生在 8 月 28 日凌晨满月时。它可能会导致满月（绰号“鲟鱼月”）呈现出怪异的红色光芒。 就在几周前，英国经历了近 30 年来最剧烈的日偏食。 更糟糕的是，它在天空中的位置将低于地平线，从而导致一种称为月亮错觉的现象。这使得月亮看起来比平时更大、更引人注目。 日偏食将于英国夏令时 03:33 在伦敦开始，届时月球将进入地球最暗的阴影。 它将在英国夏令时 05:12 达到最大值，届时大约 90% 的月球将位于本影内。 此时，月亮将位于西南天空中很低的位置，从而造成所谓的月亮错觉。 这是一个术语，指的是当月球看起来比它在天空中的位置大得多时，这是由我们的大脑处理视觉信息的方式引起的。 这种效应在月出或月落期间尤其明显，此时月盘与地面上熟悉的物体并排出现。 当地球经过太阳和月球之间时，就会发生月食，导致月球暂时移入地球的阴影中。 在日偏食期间，只有月球的一部分进入阴影最暗的部分，即本影。 穿过地球大气层的阳光会被散射，波长较短的蓝色光更容易散射，而更多波长较长的红光到达月球。 然后这些波长被反射回地球，使月食呈现出微红色。 为了获得观看日食的最佳机会，天文学家建议寻找一个可以一览无余地看到西南地平线的高处。 预计周五凌晨英国各地的观看情况会有很大差异。 由于低压，云和大阵雨可能会影响该国的部分地区，而其他地区则保持晴朗。 目前，英格兰和威尔士中部和东部地区的观看条件预计最佳。然而，即使在这里，云量在一小时与下一小时之间也可能发生很大变化，并且很难准确预测。 您可以在线或通过 BBC 天气应用程序查看最新的每小时天气预报。

title.en: Goat sanctuary purchases 16.9 acres of more land
title.zh: 山羊保护区购买了 16.9 英亩的土地

summary.en: The land purchased by Buttercups Sanctuary for Goats will enable it to house up to 160 goats.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A goat sanctuary in Kent has purchased an additional 16.9 acres of land, which it said would enable it to house up to 160 goats.

Buttercups Sanctuary for Goats in Boughton Monchelsea said that the new plot of land was close to where it was currently situated and would provide "long-lasting results for both our adorable residents and the wider, beautiful countryside".

Matt Huggins said that it was the "most significant step since the charity's foundation".

"It's been something we've all been dreaming of for a long, long time, and we're all very excited to get going," Huggins added.

According to the sanctuary, the purchased plot of land had historically been used for agriculture and will enable it to rescue more goats and double its on-site capacity.

It said a lot of work would need to be carried out on the land despite being a "blank canvas", but new goats are expected to begin living there by spring 2027.

Huggins added that its long-term vision included solar panels, wind turbines and habitat networks for the wildlife, which he expected would take years to be fully completed.

"There's a long road ahead, and we are going to need the help of our supporters to make it a final reality, but we've taken the first major step," he said.

title.en: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
title.zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，世界海洋达到有记录以来的最高温度

summary.en: The record "is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress", according to Dr Samantha Burgess from the European Copernicus climate change service.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The world's oceans are hotter than ever recorded, new data suggests, as they suffer from human-caused climate change and the growing El Niño weather phenomenon.

The average surface temperature of the planet's seas outside the polar regions hit 21.1C (70F) on Saturday, according to figures from the European Copernicus climate change service.

That edges past the 21.09C recorded on three separate days in March 2024, and is far above average for the time of year.

Warmer oceans can have wide-reaching consequences, including supercharging extreme weather, raising sea levels and harming marine life.

"This record is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress," said Dr Samantha Burgess, deputy director of Copernicus.

"El Niño is adding heat to the system, but it is doing so on top of decades of human-driven warming," she added.

The data is based on sea temperatures 10m (32ft 10in) below the surface, using measurements from buoys, ships and satellites, which are combined to produce a global estimate.

While the margin of record is currently very small and any global estimate comes with uncertainties, scientists say its timing is particularly notable.

Average worldwide sea temperatures tend to reach their yearly peak in March or April, which corresponds to the end of summer in the southern hemisphere - and not in August.

The southern hemisphere contains more of the planet's ocean surface than the northern hemisphere and so exerts a bigger influence on average sea temperatures.

What is especially concerning to scientists is that the oceans are already so hot when the natural El Niño weather phenomenon is still some way off its expected peak.

El Niño brings unusually warm waters to the surface of the eastern and central tropical Pacific Ocean. Warmer waters across such a large area means that global average temperatures typically spike too.

El Niño is expected to keep strengthening until Christmas time, with scientists warning that it is on course to be the strongest in centuries .

"The fact that we are already breaking records is an early indicator of how strong the El Niño is becoming," said Dr Jeremy Grist, senior research fellow at the National Oceanography Centre in Southampton.

"All things being equal we might expect the ocean temperature record to be broken again in March [or] April 2027," he added.

The waters far away from El Niño's Pacific hunting ground are also extremely warm, including around the UK and Europe.

The western English Channel has seen almost continuous marine heatwave conditions for more than three years, peaking at 7C above normal in July, according to Prof Tim Smyth, director of science at Plymouth Marine Laboratory.

Scientists say such widespread warmth around the planet is a clear sign of the growing effect...
body.zh: 新数据显示，由于人为气候变化和日益严重的厄尔尼诺天气现象，世界海洋的温度比以往任何时候都要高。 根据欧洲哥白尼气候变化服务机构的数据，周六极地以外的地球海洋表面平均温度达到 21.1 摄氏度（70 华氏度）。 这一气温略高于 2024 年 3 月连续三天记录的 21.09 摄氏度，远高于一年中该时期的平均气温。 海洋变暖可能会产生广泛的影响，包括加剧极端天气、海平面上升和损害海洋生物。 哥白尼副主任萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士说：“这一记录是海洋压力日益增大的又一个明显信号。” 她补充说：“厄尔尼诺现象正在给系统增加热量，但这是在数十年人为导致的变暖的基础上发生的。” 该数据基于海面以下 10 m（32 英尺 10 英寸）的海水温度，使用浮标、船舶和卫星的测量结果，将这些数据结合起来得出全球估计值。 虽然目前的记录差距非常小，而且任何全球估计都存在不确定性，但科学家表示，其时机尤其值得注意。 全球平均海水温度往往在三月或四月达到年度峰值，这对应于南半球的夏末，而不是八月。 南半球比北半球拥有更多的地球海洋表面，因此对平均海洋温度的影响更大。 让科学家们特别担心的是，当自然厄尔尼诺天气现象距离预期峰值还有一段距离时，海洋已经如此炎热。 厄尔尼诺现象给东部和中部热带太平洋表面带来异常温暖的海水。如此大面积的水域变暖意味着全球平均气温通常也会飙升。 厄尔尼诺现象预计将持续加强，直到圣诞节期间，科学家警告称，这将是几个世纪以来最强烈的一次。 南安普敦国家海洋学中心高级研究员杰里米·格里斯特博士说：“我们已经打破记录这一事实是厄尔尼诺现象变得多么强烈的早期指标。” 他补充道：“在所有条件相同的情况下，我们预计海洋温度记录将在 2027 年 3 月或 4 月再次被打破。” 远离厄尔尼诺现象的太平洋狩猎场的水域也非常温暖，包括英国和欧洲周围的水域。 普利茅斯海洋实验室科学主任蒂姆·史密斯教授表示，三年多来，西英吉利海峡几乎持续出现海洋热浪天气，7月份的最高气温比正常水平高出7摄氏度。 科学家表示，地球上如此普遍的变暖现象是这种影响日益增强的明显迹象......

body.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and benzodiazepines. Some effects were still detectable years later, suggesting past medication use may strongly influence the gut bacteria people carry today.

title.en: Bird flu is spreading. Your backyard feeder could make it worse
title.zh: 禽流感正在蔓延。你的后院喂食器可能会让情况变得更糟

summary.en: Backyard bird feeders could become unexpected hotspots for H5N1 as Australia’s bird flu outbreak spreads, bringing species together in ways that rarely occur naturally. Experts say stopping feeding is safest, while smaller amounts of food, no hand-feeding, and careful cleaning...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Backyard bird feeding is one of our country’s most popular pastimes. Research reveals about half of Australian households feed wild birds, with many people doing so daily.

However, this practice could act as a superspreader event – where a disease infects an unusually high number of people or animals – of the H5N1 virus. This deadly strain of bird flu has already decimated wild bird and mammal populations worldwide. It is now spreading across Australia, most recently killing more than 1,000 crested terns and a long-nosed fur seal, the first detection in a mainland mammal.

Although many Australians feed wild birds, the practice is controversial . This is mainly due to concerns about people offering unsuitable foods and birds becoming dependent on humans.

So why is backyard bird feeding such a problem when it comes to bird flu? And can we do it safely?

People feed wild birds for various reasons , including to provide food during tough times or simply enjoy their presence. Most care deeply about their avian companions and believe feeding them is helpful .

Feeding wild birds heightens the risk of disease transmission at feeding locations . When we offer supplementary food, such as seeds or meat scraps, this attracts birds of many different species in a combination and number that would not happen in nature. They may carry deadly diseases, such as the H5N1 virus, and potentially spread them to other birds.

This can create a transmission hotspot right on our back deck. And catching bird flu can push our most threatened species, such as the orange-bellied parrot , to the brink of extinction.

The fatal effects of H5N1 are not only contained to birds. Scavenger animals such as possums, red foxes and crows can be exposed to the virus while devouring the carcasses of infected birds. Humans in close contact with infected wildlife, such as wildlife carers and veterinarians, can contract H5N1. However, human infection is rare and typically only causes mild symptoms.

Backyard bird feeding may seem like a harmless hobby. But given how many people do it, and the risks it poses to both birds and people, bird feeding activities could lead to many more wildlife deaths .

The most effective strategy is to stop feeding birds altogether. If you don’t offer food to wild birds, they will be less likely to congregate in your backyard or garden. And they will be fine without your help. Our previous research found most birds that visit feeders obtain most of their nutrition from natural sources, such as insects and worms. So the food we provide is a snack, not an essential meal.

Having feeders full of seeds and leftover meat will attract more birds. So to discourage them from congregating, simply provide less food. Much like COVID-era social...
body.zh: 后院喂鸟是我国最受欢迎的消遣之一。研究显示，大约一半的澳大利亚家庭喂养野生鸟类，其中许多人每天都这样做。 然而，这种做法可能会成为 H5N1 病毒的超级传播事件——一种疾病感染异常多的人或动物。这种致命的禽流感病毒已经导致世界各地的野生鸟类和哺乳动物数量大量减少。它目前正在澳大利亚各地蔓延，最近导致 1,000 多只凤头燕鸥和一只长鼻海豹死亡，这是首次在大陆哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 尽管许多澳大利亚人喂养野生鸟类，但这种做法存在争议。这主要是由于担心人们提供不合适的食物以及鸟类变得依赖人类。 那么，为什么在禽流感方面，后院喂鸟会成为一个问题呢？我们可以安全地做到这一点吗？ 人们出于各种原因喂养野生鸟类，包括在困难时期提供食物或只是享受它们的存在。大多数人非常关心他们的鸟类同伴，并相信喂养它们是有帮助的。 喂养野鸟会增加喂养地点疾病传播的风险。当我们提供补充食物（例如种子或肉末）时，会吸引许多不同物种的鸟类，其组合和数量在自然界中是不会发生的。它们可能携带致命疾病，例如 H5N1 病毒，并有可能将其传播给其他鸟类。 这可以在我们的后甲板上创建一个传输热点。感染禽流感可能会将橙腹鹦鹉等最受威胁的物种推向灭绝的边缘。 H5N1 的致命影响不仅限于鸟类。负鼠、红狐和乌鸦等食腐动物在吞食受感染鸟类的尸体时可能会接触到病毒。与受感染野生动物密切接触的人类，例如野生动物护理人员和兽医，可能会感染 H5N1。然而，人类感染很少见，通常只会引起轻微症状。 后院喂鸟似乎是一种无害的爱好。但考虑到有多少人这样做，以及它对鸟类和人类造成的风险，鸟类喂养活动可能会导致更多野生动物死亡。 最有效的策略是完全停止喂养鸟类。如果您不向野鸟提供食物，它们就不太可能聚集在您的后院或花园里。没有你的帮助，他们也会没事的。我们之前的研究发现，大多数访问喂食器的鸟类从昆虫和蠕虫等天然来源获取大部分营养。所以我们提供的食物是零食，而不是必需的膳食。 装满种子和剩余肉的喂食器会吸引更多的鸟类。因此，为了阻止他们聚集，只需提供更少的食物即可。就像新冠病毒时代的社交......

title.en: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
title.zh: 一条幽灵般的星带揭示了隐藏的暗物质

summary.en: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. Because the stars trace the galaxy’s gravity, researchers used the stream to estimate how much invisible dark matter surrounds it and how...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For billions of years, an ancient cluster of stars has been gradually coming apart, shedding stars that now form a faint, narrow ribbon across space. That delicate structure is offering astronomers a new way to investigate one of the universe's biggest mysteries.

An international research team, including an astrophysicist from Northwestern University, has identified the first stellar stream of this type ever observed outside the Milky Way. Astronomers have long predicted that such streams should exist around other galaxies, but their extreme faintness has made them difficult to detect.

The newly discovered stream also offers scientists an unusual tool for studying dark matter, which remains one of the major unanswered questions in astrophysics. By analyzing the stream's shape, researchers reconstructed the gravitational field of its host galaxy and used that information to determine how unseen dark matter influenced the stars' paths.

The findings could eventually help scientists investigate how dark matter is distributed across many different galaxies and throughout the universe.

"The stars in a stellar stream all travel along nearly the same orbit, and that orbit is shaped by the galaxy's gravity," said Northwestern's Tjitske Starkenburg, who coauthored the study. "By modeling that gravity, we can estimate the galaxy's total mass. We already know roughly how much of that mass comes from visible matter like stars, so the rest must be dark matter."

Starkenburg, an expert in extragalactic astronomy, is a research assistant professor at Northwestern's Center for Interdisciplinary Exploration and Research in Astrophysics. The study was co-led by Julie Kiel Holm of the University of Copenhagen and Sarah Pearson of the Technical University of Denmark.

Globular clusters are densely packed groups of stars held together by gravity. As one of these clusters travels around its host galaxy, the galaxy's gravitational pull can slowly strip stars away from it.

Those stars do not simply scatter in every direction. Instead, they tend to continue along nearly the same orbital path, creating long, thin stellar streams that retain information about the gravitational forces they have experienced.

Astronomers have identified dozens of streams produced by globular clusters inside the Milky Way. Until now, however, no comparable stream had been detected in another galaxy. Such structures are generally so faint that they disappear against the light of their host galaxies.

The breakthrough came through archival observations from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope presented by study coauthors David Sand and Catherine Fielder, both astronomers at the University of Arizona. While study coauthor David Hendel was examining images of the ultra-diffuse galaxy UGC 9050-Dw1 for...
body.zh: 数十亿年来，古老的星团逐渐分裂，脱落的恒星现在在太空中形成一条微弱而狭窄的丝带。这种微妙的结构为天文学家提供了一种研究宇宙最大谜团之一的新方法。 包括西北大学天体物理学家在内的一个国际研究小组发现了在银河系外首次观测到的此类恒星流。天文学家长期以来一直预测，此类流应该存在于其他星系周围，但它们的极度微弱使它们难以被发现。 新发现的暗物质流还为科学家提供了一种不寻常的工具来研究暗物质，暗物质仍然是天体物理学中尚未解答的主要问题之一。通过分析该流的形状，研究人员重建了其宿主星系的引力场，并利用该信息来确定看不见的暗物质如何影响恒星的路径。 这些发现最终可以帮助科学家研究暗物质如何分布在许多不同的星系和整个宇宙中。 “恒星流中的恒星都沿着几乎相同的轨道运行，而该轨道是由星系的引力决定的，”西北大学的蒂斯克·斯塔肯堡（Tjitske Starkenburg）说，他是这项研究的合著者。 “通过对引力进行建模，我们可以估计星系的总质量。我们已经大致知道其中有多少质量来自恒星等可见物质，所以其余的一定是暗物质。” 斯塔肯伯格是河外天文学专家，西北大学天体物理学跨学科探索与研究中心的研究助理教授。这项研究由哥本哈根大学的 Julie Kiel Holm 和丹麦技术大学的 Sarah Pearson 共同领导。 球状星团是由重力聚集在一起的密集恒星群。当这些星团之一围绕其宿主星系运行时，星系的引力会慢慢地将恒星从它身上剥离。 这些星星并不简单地分散在各个方向。相反，它们倾向于继续沿着几乎相同的轨道路径运行，产生又长又细的恒星流，保留有关它们所经历的引力的信息。 天文学家已经发现了银河系内部球状星团产生的数十条流。然而，到目前为止，尚未在另一个星系中检测到类似的流。这些结构通常非常微弱，以至于它们在宿主星系的光线下消失了。 这一突破来自美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的档案观测，该观测由研究合著者、亚利桑那大学的天文学家大卫·桑德和凯瑟琳·菲尔德提出。当研究合著者 David Hendel 正在检查超漫射星系 UGC 9050-Dw1 的图像时……

title.en: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster
title.zh: 睡眠过多或过少都可能使身体衰老得更快

summary.en: Both too little and too much sleep may be linked to faster aging throughout the body. Researchers analyzing 23 biological aging clocks found the lowest aging levels among people sleeping about 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day. Short or long sleep was also associated with numerous...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A new analysis of biological aging across the human body suggests that both sleeping too little and sleeping too much are associated with faster aging in the brain, heart, lungs, immune system, and other organs. These sleep patterns were also linked to a broad range of diseases.

"Previous studies have found that sleep is largely linked to aging and the pathological burden of the brain. Our study goes further and shows that too little and too much sleep are associated with faster aging in nearly every organ, supporting the idea that sleep is important in maintaining organ health within a coordinated brain-body network, including metabolic balance and a healthy immune system," says study leader Junhao Wen, assistant professor of radiology at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.

Scientists are increasingly using aging clocks to estimate whether a person is aging biologically faster or slower than their chronological age. These tools rely on machine learning and biological information (e.g., proteins from a minimally invasive blood test) to calculate patterns associated with aging.

Many aging clocks provide a single measure for the entire body. However, different organs can age at different speeds. One familiar example is the decline in ovarian function that contributes to the biological clock associated with female fertility.

Wen and his colleagues have been developing aging clocks that focus on individual organs. The goal is to provide more detailed and potentially more personalized information about a person's health.

"Everyone is excited by these aging clocks and their ability to predict disease and mortality risk," Wen says. "But to me, the more exciting question is, can we link aging clocks to a lifestyle factor that can be modified in time to slow aging?"

Sleep offered researchers an ideal way to explore that question because mounting evidence suggests that sleep plays an important role in health. Wen also had a personal interest in the issue.

"I'm also a light sleeper and was getting worried about the effects on myself," says Wen.

To create the aging clocks, Wen used information from about half a million participants in the UK Biobank. Machine learning was applied to identify biological signatures associated with aging in different organs.

The researchers built clocks using several types of information, including structural measurements from medical imaging, proteins associated with specific organs, and molecules detected in the blood.

"In the liver, for example, we have an aging clock built with protein data, an aging clock of metabolic data, and an aging clock of imaging data," Wen says. "This allows us to see whether sleep is distinctively associated with aging clocks derived from multiple omics and...
body.zh: 一项对人体生物衰老的新分析表明，睡眠过少和睡眠过多都与大脑、心脏、肺、免疫系统和其他器官的加速衰老有关。这些睡眠模式也与多种疾病有关。 “之前的研究发现，睡眠在很大程度上与衰老和大脑的病理负担有关。我们的研究进一步表明，睡眠太少和太多都与几乎每个器官的衰老速度加快有关，这支持了这样的观点，即睡眠对于维持协调的脑体网络中的器官健康非常重要，包括代谢平衡和健康的免疫系统，”研究负责人、哥伦比亚大学瓦格洛斯内外科医学院放射学助理教授温俊豪说。 科学家越来越多地使用衰老时钟来估计一个人的生物学衰老速度是否比实际年龄快或慢。这些工具依靠机器学习和生物信息（例如，微创血液测试中的蛋白质）来计算与衰老相关的模式。 许多老化时钟为整个身体提供单一测量。然而，不同的器官会以不同的速度老化。一个熟悉的例子是卵巢功能下降，这会影响与女性生育能力相关的生物钟。 温和他的同事们一直在开发关注个体器官的衰老时钟。目标是提供有关个人健康的更详细且可能更个性化的信息。 “每个人都对这些衰老时钟及其预测疾病和死亡风险的能力感到兴奋，”文说。 “但对我来说，更令人兴奋的问题是，我们能否将衰老时钟与可以及时改变以减缓衰老的生活方式因素联系起来？” 睡眠为研究人员提供了探索这个问题的理想方法，因为越来越多的证据表明睡眠在健康中发挥着重要作用。温家宝对这个问题也有个人兴趣。 “我的睡眠质量也很浅，我很担心这对自己造成的影响，”文说。 为了创建衰老时钟，温使用了英国生物银行约 50 万参与者的信息。应用机器学习来识别与不同器官衰老相关的生物特征。 研究人员利用多种类型的信息构建了时钟，包括医学成像的结构测量、与特定器官相关的蛋白质以及血液中检测到的分子。 “例如，在肝脏中，我们有一个由蛋白质数据构建的衰老时钟、一个代谢数据的衰老时钟和一个成像数据的衰老时钟，”文说。 “这使我们能够了解睡眠是否与来自多个组学的衰老时钟有明显的相关性，并且......

title.en: Screen time at ages 1 and 6 may matter more than parents realize
title.zh: 1 岁和 6 岁的屏幕时间可能比父母意识到的更重要

summary.en: More screen time during infancy and around the start of school was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later. The findings suggest that early childhood may contain particularly sensitive windows when screen habits can have longer-lasting effects.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Screens are now a routine part of life for many young children, raising growing questions about how early exposure could influence development over time. New longitudinal research that tracked children from age 1 through age 8 found that greater screen viewing, especially during infancy and around the time children begin school, was associated with lower academic performance at age 9 and weaker working memory at age 10.5. The results suggest that when children are exposed to screens could matter just as much as how much time they spend using them.

The World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Academy of Pediatrics recommend avoiding screen use before 18-24 months and limiting it to less than one hour per day for children ages 2 to 5. Many children, however, spend more time with screens than those guidelines advise. Research into the effects of screen viewing on cognitive development has also produced mixed results. Much of the previous work has relied on snapshots taken at a single point in time, focused mainly on school-age children, or lacked repeated measurements throughout early childhood. Studies that follow children across several developmental stages can help identify periods when screen exposure may be especially important while also accounting more effectively for family and environmental factors.

Researchers from Inserm and the National University of Singapore conducted the study, which was published in the World Journal of Pediatrics . Using information from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) birth cohort, the team examined parent-reported screen viewing at six different ages. They then compared those measurements with children's academic performance and working memory several years later.

The analysis included 502 children who were followed from infancy into middle childhood. Higher screen viewing during certain stages of development was associated with poorer academic results later on and weaker working memory. The clearest patterns appeared for screen exposure during infancy and near the beginning of formal schooling, indicating that these periods may be particularly sensitive for cognitive development.

Children who accumulated more screen exposure across childhood also tended to perform less well academically. Together, the findings suggest that total viewing time is only part of the picture. The age at which heavier screen use occurs may also be important, with early childhood potentially representing a period when screen habits have longer-term implications for learning and memory.

body.zh: 现在，屏幕已成为许多幼儿生活的一部分，这引发了越来越多的问题，即早期接触屏幕会如何影响长期的发育。新的追踪 1 岁至 8 岁儿童的纵向研究发现，更多的屏幕观看时间，尤其是在婴儿期和孩子开始上学前后，与 9 岁时学业成绩较低和 10.5 岁时工作记忆较弱有关。研究结果表明，孩子接触屏幕的时间与他们使用屏幕的时间一样重要。 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 和美国儿科学会建议在 18 至 24 个月大之前避免使用屏幕，并将 2 至 5 岁的儿童每天使用屏幕的时间限制在不到一小时。然而，许多儿童花在屏幕上的时间比指南建议的要多。关于屏幕观看对认知发展影响的研究也产生了不同的结果。之前的大部分工作都依赖于在单个时间点拍摄的快照，主要关注学龄儿童，或者缺乏整个幼儿期的重复测量。对儿童各个发展阶段进行跟踪研究可以帮助确定屏幕暴露可能特别重要的时期，同时还可以更有效地考虑家庭和环境因素。 来自 Inserm 和新加坡国立大学的研究人员进行了这项研究，该研究发表在《世界儿科杂志》上。研究小组利用新加坡成长健康成果 (GUSTO) 出生队列的信息，检查了家长报告的六个不同年龄段的屏幕观看情况。然后，他们将这些测量结果与几年后儿童的学习成绩和工作记忆进行了比较。 该分析涵盖了 502 名从婴儿期到童年中期的儿童。在某些发展阶段，较高的屏幕观看次数与后来较差的学业成绩和较弱的工作记忆有关。最清晰的模式出现在婴儿期和接近正规学校教育开始时的屏幕暴露，这表明这些时期可能对认知发展特别敏感。 童年时期接触屏幕越多的孩子学业成绩也往往较差。总之，研究结果表明，总观看时间只是整体情况的一部分。大量使用屏幕的年龄也可能很重要，幼儿期可能代表屏幕习惯对学习和记忆产生长期影响的时期。 作者说：“我们在 1 岁时看到的效应大小是我们检查的所有时间点中最大的。” “这表明婴儿早期可能是敏感性增强的一个窗口，此时正在发育的大脑......

title.en: Two planned datacentres will have higher UK carbon emissions than ExxonMobil, analysis finds

summary.en: Exclusive: Buckinghamshire and Bedfordshire sites predicted to emit 4.5m tonnes a year when fully running The carbon emissions from just two planned datacentres in England will exceed all of the fossil fuel company ExxonMobil’s UK emissions, analysis has revealed. Experts have...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Exclusive: Buckinghamshire and Bedfordshire sites predicted to emit 4.5m tonnes a year when fully running

The carbon emissions from just two planned datacentres in England will exceed all of the fossil fuel company ExxonMobil’s UK emissions, analysis has revealed.

Experts have said this demonstrates the “serious threat” datacentres pose to the UK’s legally binding climate goals.

Analysis by the non-profit group Foxglove reveals that when fully operational, the Wapseys Wood datacentre in Buckinghamshire and the Quest Park datacentre in Bedfordshire will use 1.3GW of power and will produce more than 4.5m tonnes of carbon emissions.

ExxonMobil emitted 3.9m tonnes in 2023, according to the global energy thinktank Ember.

AI datacentres use a massive amount of electricity to power servers and cooling equipment, and to run facility systems. There are currently 315 datacentres in the queue to connect to the UK’s electricity grid, representing 73GW of demand. This is almost double the peak winter energy demand for the entire UK.

Because of the long wait to connect to the grid, the Wapseys Wood and Quest Park datacentres are seeking to build their own on-site gas-fired power stations.

Based on government figures on the carbon intensity of electricity generation, Foxglove has calculated these projects will produce 4.577m tonnes of carbon emissions per year.

A government spokesperson said these figures were “misleading” because of the assumption that both projects will run at 100% utilisation from day one, which they said was “not accurate”.

Tom Hegarty, head of communications at Foxglove, said assuming a 100% utilisation rate followed standard industry practice.

Kierra Box, a trade and environmental regulation campaigner at Friends of the Earth, said the aim was for datacentres to increase load and run at full capacity, and so it was “valid to look at those top level predictions”.

The former England and Wales Green party leader Caroline Lucas described the projected emissions from these projects as “absolutely horrifying”, and said it should be ringing alarm bells right across government.

The government says its own analysis shows there are multiple pathways for this rapid datacentre rollout to fit within the seventh carbon budget , which sets out how the government will reach its international climate targets.

Toby Perkins, a Labour MP and chair of the Commons environmental audit committee, which is leading an inquiry into the environmental impact of datacentres, said this analysis was a “potent reminder that without the right measures in place, data centres could represent a serious threat to the environment and to our legally binding climate goals”.

Oliver Hayes, head of policy at the campaign group Global Action Plan, said the two projects...
body.zh: 独家：白金汉郡和贝德福德郡工厂全面运行后预计每年排放 450 万吨 分析显示，仅英格兰规划的两个数据中心的碳排放量就将超过化石燃料公司埃克森美孚在英国的全部排放量。 专家表示，这表明数据中心对英国具有法律约束力的气候目标构成了“严重威胁”。 非盈利组织 Foxglove 的分析显示，全面运营后，白金汉郡的 Wapseys Wood 数据中心和贝德福德郡的 Quest Park 数据中心将使用 1.3GW 的电力，并将产生超过 450 万吨的碳排放。 根据全球能源智库 Ember 的数据，埃克森美孚 2023 年排放量为 390 万吨。 人工智能数据中心使用大量电力来为服务器和冷却设备供电以及运行设施系统。目前有 315 个数据中心正在排队连接英国电网，代表着 73GW 的需求。这几乎是整个英国冬季能源需求高峰的两倍。 由于连接电网需要等待很长时间，Wapseys Wood 和 Quest Park 数据中心正在寻求建立自己的现场燃气发电站。 根据政府关于发电碳强度的数据，Foxglove 计算出这些项目每年将产生 457.7 万吨碳排放。 一位政府发言人表示，这些数字具有“误导性”，因为他们假设这两个项目从第一天起就将以 100% 的利用率运行，但他们表示这种假设“不准确”。 Foxglove 通讯主管 Tom Hegarty 表示，假设 100% 的利用率符合标准行业惯例。 地球之友的贸易和环境监管活动家 Kierra Box 表示，其目标是让数据中心增加负载并满负荷运行，因此“看看这些高层预测是正确的”。 前英格兰和威尔士绿党领袖卡罗琳·卢卡斯将这些项目的预计排放量描述为“绝对可怕”，并表示这应该给整个政府敲响警钟。 政府表示，其自己的分析显示，这种快速数据中心的推出有多种途径可以适应第七个碳预算，该预算规定了政府将如何实现其国际气候目标。 工党议员兼下议院环境审计委员会主席托比·珀金斯 (Toby Perkins) 正在领导对数据中心对环境影响的调查，他表示这项分析“有力地提醒我们，如果没有采取正确的措施，数据中心可能会对环境和我们具有法律约束力的气候目标构成严重威胁”。 全球行动计划运动组织的政策负责人奥利弗·海耶斯表示，这两个项目......

summary.en: Developer Patrick Grant was born in Australia and lives in New Zealand, but a childhood of British TV inspired him to set a comedy game in a bleak vision of the north Something is amiss in the dingy town of Slagford, and curious scamp Pip Bunting is the only one who can find out...

body.en: Developer Patrick Grant was born in Australia and lives in New Zealand, but a childhood of British TV inspired him to set a comedy game in a bleak vision of the north Something is amiss in the dingy town of Slagford, and curious scamp Pip Bunting is the only one who can find out what. So quit your mithering, it’s time to discover just how grim it truly is up north. A Pocket Full of Slagford is an upcoming retro-styled 3D puzzle adventure game set in a surreal alternative-reality near-future northern England that never escaped the clutches of Thatcherism. The story follows the misadventures of a young local lad from the eponymous Slagford after he takes ownership of a mysterious relic that lets him wreak havoc on reality. Continue reading...
body.zh: 开发商帕特里克·格兰特 (Patrick Grant) 出生于澳大利亚，现居新西兰，但英国电视的童年启发他将一款喜剧游戏设定在北方的凄凉景象中。 肮脏的斯拉格福德小镇出了问题，好奇的流氓皮普·邦廷 (Pip Bunting) 是唯一能找出问题所在的人。所以，别再胡思乱想了，是时候去看看北方到底有多严峻了。 《A Pocket Full of Slagford》是一款即将推出的复古风格 3D 解谜冒险游戏，背景设定在近未来的超现实另类现实英格兰北部，从未逃脱过撒切尔主义的魔爪。故事讲述了一位来自同名斯拉格福德的当地小伙子在获得了一件神秘遗物后的不幸遭遇，这件遗物让他对现实造成了严重破坏。继续阅读...

body.en: As people grow used to AI chatbots, we’d like to hear your views about Google’s search engine Google has put artificial intelligence at the front and center of its search bar. The most-visited site on the internet still shows the same list of links to users, but they have to scroll past a summarized response from an AI chatbot, a feature Google calls AI Overviews. The change to what was once the gateway to the rest of the internet has been profound, and the browsing habits of billions of people are shifting. “AI is driving the most significant upgrade of the Google Search experience ever,” Liz Reid, Google’s vice-president of search, wrote last August . In May, the company said more AI is coming . Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着人们逐渐习惯人工智能聊天机器人，我们想听听您对谷歌搜索引擎的看法谷歌已将人工智能置于其搜索栏的前端和中心位置。互联网上访问量最大的网站仍然向用户显示相同的链接列表，但他们必须滚动浏览人工智能聊天机器人的汇总响应，谷歌将这一功能称为人工智能概述。曾经通往互联网其他部分的门户发生了深刻的变化，数十亿人的浏览习惯正在发生变化。谷歌搜索副总裁 Liz Reid 去年 8 月写道：“人工智能正在推动谷歌搜索体验有史以来最重大的升级。”五月份，该公司表示即将推出更多人工智能。继续阅读...
