title.en: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止人工智能创作的歌曲

summary.en: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Songs that are largely or wholly created by AI have been banned from Australia's music charts.

The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) said the new code would help "promote the human nature of artistry".

It follows a controversy around a cover of Madonna's Like A Prayer by Australian DJ Josh Fawaz which recently topped the ARIA dance singles chart and peaked at number 2 on the country's overall chart.

The song has become a staple of commercial radio station playlists and been streamed more than 48 million times on Spotify alone.

ARIA said that Australian artists were competing for attention "in the most crowded market in history" and that it was "not interested in promoting or celebrating the success of AI-generated music that does not contain human artistry".

Under the new rules, AI assistance can still be used, but humans must have written the song, and have performed the lead vocal and primary instruments.

AI can also still be used for mastering songs and, for example, using drum machines and auto tune.

Earlier this year a song was banned from Sweden's music charts because it was created by AI.

And in July, the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) said AI guidelines would be rolled out in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia for use in their official charts.

The updated code, based on the IFPI directive, also excludes music that raises "stream or chart manipulation concerns".

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said: "These changes reflect our intent to remain dynamic and promote the human nature of artistry in what is, to say the least, a rapidly developing space."

"Artists already use AI tools in their work, the charts can and should evolve to keep room for that, but music generated wholesale by services built on artists' recordings is a different matter."

She added: "A chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent."

Artists will be required to declare AI use when they submit a song for chart consideration.

ARIA said that if it later emerged music was largely AI-generated it could retrospectively adjust chart positions, and if the piece topped the charts, it may request that awards given for reaching Number One were returned.

Last month, they shared an AI-assisted version of their 2014 hit High on Instagram, captioned: "When you re-record your own song with AI so Australian radio will play it."

Band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show that AI-generated music was "removing the human experience from life".

In July this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised "the strongest possible protection" from AI for Australian creatives.

title.en: AI is hitting entry-level jobs hardest, Stanford study finds
title.zh: 斯坦福大学研究发现，人工智能对入门级工作的打击最大

summary.en: Young employment in AI-impacted fields down 19% compared to more AI-resistant occupations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: For years , AI industry watchers of all stripes have been warning of a coming jobs apocalypse driven by ultra-intelligent AI systems that will be able to replicate most human tasks more cheaply. Now, newly updated research from Stanford University economists suggests AI seems to be causing significant entry-level job losses for younger workers in some fields, even as older workers appear largely unaffected so far. The August 2026 edition of "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence" updates and revises a paper of the same name published last year with fresh data and refined statistics. In that update, the Stanford researchers find the employment trends they identified for entry-level workers last year are persisting and expanding. Specifically, employment levels for workers aged 22 to 25 in the most "AI-exposed" occupations are now 19 percent below those of their peers in fields less exposed to AI disruption. Last year, that gap measured just 13 percent. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 多年来，各行各业的人工智能行业观察家一直警告称，由超智能人工智能系统驱动的就业灾难即将到来，这些系统将能够以更便宜的成本复制大多数人类任务。现在，斯坦福大学经济学家最新的研究表明，人工智能似乎正在导致某些领域的年轻工人大量入门级失业，尽管老年工人到目前为止似乎基本上没有受到影响。 2026 年 8 月版《煤矿里的金丝雀？人工智能近期就业影响的六个事实》更新和修订了去年发表的同名论文，提供了新的数据和精细的统计数据。在那次更新中，斯坦福大学的研究人员发现，他们去年确定的入门级工人的就业趋势正在持续存在并扩大。具体来说，从事“受人工智能影响最大”职业的 22 至 25 岁工人的就业水平目前比受人工智能影响较少的领域的同龄人低 19%。去年，这一差距仅为 13%。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Data centers become "killer application" for new power transformer tech
title.zh: 数据中心成为新型电力变压器技术的“杀手级应用”

summary.en: Solid-state transformers could also benefit EV charging and someday households.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Data centers have become the largest driver of surging electricity demand that is straining US power grids. But the AI data center boom has also accelerated investment in a technology that could provide a silver lining for everyone—solid-state power transformers that replace industrial-age technology with modern power electronics. Power grids currently rely on conventional transformer technology that is painstakingly assembled by hand and has a fundamental design dating back to the 1880s. Two copper wire coils manually wound around a steel core create electromagnetic fields that help step up voltage levels of alternating current electricity for long-distance transmission or step down voltage levels for the electricity use of homes and businesses. The largest power transformers cannot be mass-manufactured but are instead custom-built for each utility company’s electrical substations. Manufacturing constraints, coupled with the scramble to upgrade US power infrastructure, have meant utility companies and other customers must wait up to several years for delivery of new power transformers. That is not only a problem for expanding power grid infrastructure to support growing electricity demand, but also delays the process of replacing aging power transformers. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 数据中心已成为电力需求激增的最大推动力，这给美国电网带来了压力。但人工智能数据中心的繁荣也加速了对一项技术的投资，这项技术可以为每个人带来一线希望——用现代电力电子技术取代工业时代技术的固态电力变压器。目前，电网依赖于手工精心组装的传统变压器技术，其基本设计可以追溯到 1880 年代。手动缠绕在钢芯上的两个铜线线圈会产生电磁场，有助于提高交流电的电压水平以进行长距离传输，或降低电压水平以供家庭和企业用电。最大的电力变压器无法大规模制造，而是为每个公用事业公司的变电站定制。制造限制，加上美国电力基础设施升级的争夺，意味着公用事业公司和其他客户必须等待数年才能交付新的电力变压器。这不仅是扩大电网基础设施以支持不断增长的电力需求的问题，而且还推迟了更换老化电力变压器的进程。阅读全文 评论

title.en: RFK Jr. may upend how vaccine recommendations are categorized
title.zh: RFK Jr. 可能会颠覆疫苗建议的分类方式

summary.en: There are currently 3 categories. Without reason, RFK Jr. is considering changes.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Under anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the US health department is considering changing how vaccine recommendations are categorized and described. The move creates the possibility that vaccinations currently considered "routine" or "universal" could be given new designations that sound less definitive or more conditional, such as "recommended with qualification" or recommended based on "shared clinical decision-making." Kennedy has made no new rules or recommendations for the categories yet. However, he laid out ideas and possibilities in a Request for Information (RFI) posted online Friday and published in the Federal Register on Monday . In the 10-page document , Kennedy poses questions about the current categories and asks the public to weigh in on ideas for how to change or replace them. The deadline to comment on the questions and ideas is September 20. Currently, there are three categories of vaccination recommendations granted by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which is informed by a panel of independent expert advisors, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP). The three categories are: routine, otherwise considered universal (a recommendation that everyone should get a vaccine); risk-based recommendations (only certain groups at higher risk should get a vaccine); and recommendations based on "shared clinical decision-making," or SCDM (a flexible but uncommon recommendation for vaccination based on the characteristics, values, and preferences of a patient and the judgment of their healthcare provider). Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在反疫苗的卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的领导下，美国卫生部门正在考虑改变疫苗建议的分类和描述方式。此举创造了一种可能性，即目前被认为是“常规”或“通用”的疫苗可能会被赋予新的名称，这些名称听起来不那么明确或更有条件，例如“有资格推荐”或基于“共同临床决策”推荐。肯尼迪尚未针对这些类别制定新的规则或建议。不过，他在周五在线发布并于周一在《联邦公报》上发表的信息请求 (RFI) 中阐述了想法和可能性。在这份长达 10 页的文件中，肯尼迪提出了有关当前类别的问题，并要求公众就如何改变或取代它们提出意见。对问题和想法发表评论的截止日期是 9 月 20 日。目前，疾病控制和预防中心授予了三类疫苗接种建议，这些建议由独立专家顾问小组、免疫实践咨询委员会 (ACIP) 提供信息。这三个类别是：常规的，否则被认为是普遍的（建议每个人都应该接种疫苗）；基于风险的建议（只有某些风险较高的群体才应该接种疫苗）；基于“共同临床决策”或 SCDM 的建议（根据患者的特征、价值观和偏好及其医疗保健提供者的判断而提出的灵活但不常见的疫苗接种建议）。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Ads and tracking infiltrated TVs. Now they're coming for monitors.
title.zh: 广告和跟踪渗透到电视中。现在他们来找显示器了。

summary.en: Monitor vendors are playing with fire.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Ads and tracking have turned TVs into privacy nightmares . Both are so widespread among smart TVs that I’ve written a guide for avoiding them . One recommendation in that guide is to use a computer monitor. But in recent years, monitors have become more capable of pushing ads and tracking users. Without more straightforward approaches from vendors, such as easily comprehensible privacy policies and avoiding inappropriate ads, monitors are dangerously encroaching into smart-TV-like territory. LG monitors’ McAfee ads LG lost some trust after a recent report that some of its monitors installed McAfee pop-up ads onto connected computers . Since at least 2024 , some of these displays installed an app, LG Monitor App Installer, onto connected computers under the cover of driver updates installed through Windows Update. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 广告和跟踪已将电视变成了隐私噩梦。这两种情况在智能电视中都非常普遍，因此我编写了一份避免它们的指南。该指南中的一项建议是使用计算机显示器。但近年来，显示器推送广告和跟踪用户的能力变得越来越强。如果供应商没有采取更直接的方法，例如易于理解的隐私政策和避免不当广告，显示器就会危险地侵入类似智能电视的领域。 LG 显示器的迈克菲广告 最近有报道称 LG 显示器的一些显示器在联网计算机上安装了迈克菲弹出广告，导致 LG 失去了一些信任。至少从 2024 年开始，其中一些显示器在通过 Windows 更新安装的驱动程序更新的掩护下，在连接的计算机上安装了一个应用程序 LG Monitor App Installer。阅读全文 评论

title.en: GM vehicles under federal scrutiny after hundreds of reports
title.zh: 数百份报告后，通用汽车汽车接受联邦审查

summary.en: The eBoost brake-by-wire system is responsible for at least 22 crashes now.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The federal government is expanding a safety investigation into a number of vehicles manufactured by General Motors after receiving hundreds of reports of brake failure. The problem affects more than 1.1 million cars, including many of GM's electric vehicles, as well as ones it has built for Honda and Acura. The problem is with the brake-by-wire system (which GM calls eBoost ), which can suffer a spindle fracture while driving. GM says that in the event of that happening, the car should still retain a number of critical safety features—antilock brakes, traction control, and stability control—at least until it comes to a complete stop, at which point they become inoperable. But NHTSA's ODI says that it has received many reports that contradict this behavior and allege that eBoost failures are followed by an immediate loss of braking, which obviously poses a safety risk. Indeed, NHTSA has received 227 incident reports, a number that grows to 745 once you include the hundreds of occurrences reported to GM. Twenty-two cases resulted in crashes, and while six people have been injured in five crashes, thankfully there have been no fatal incidents. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在收到数百份制动故障报告后，联邦政府正在扩大对通用汽车制造的一些车辆的安全调查。该问题影响了超过 110 万辆汽车，其中包括通用汽车的许多电动汽车，以及为本田和讴歌生产的汽车。问题出在线控制动系统（通用汽车称之为 eBoost ）上，该系统在行驶时可能会发生主轴断裂。通用汽车表示，如果发生这种情况，汽车仍应保留一些关键的安全功能——防抱死制动、牵引力控制和稳定性控制——至少直到它完全停止为止，此时它们将变得无法操作。但 NHTSA 的 ODI 表示，它已收到许多与这种行为相矛盾的报告，并声称 eBoost 故障后会立即失去制动能力，这显然会带来安全风险。事实上，NHTSA 已收到 227 起事故报告，如果算上向通用汽车报告的数百起事故，这一数字将增至 745 起。有 22 起事故导致了车祸，虽然 5 起事故中有 6 人受伤，但幸运的是没有发生致命事故。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Inaudible sounds used to fingerprint browsers catch AliExpress red-handed
title.zh: 用于指纹浏览器的听不见的声音让速卖通当场被捕

summary.en: Is the technique outdated? Yes. Is it still creepy? Also yes.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chinese retailer AliExpress has been caught fingerprinting visitors after one of the metrics—an outdated technique that measures inaudible sounds it sends to browsers—impeded a researcher's ability to use his bluetooth headphones. Researcher Matthew Callaghan said he stumbled on the stealthy tracking by mistake. After loading the AliExpress homepage, audio from his phone stopped playing over his multipoint headphones, which accept connections from more than one device at a time. He set the headphones to play sounds from his phone except when his PC was producing audio. Each time he loaded AliExpress, the phone audio stopped. Each time he closed the tab the site was loaded into, the phone was once again audible. Users can't hear it, but browsers can While investigating the odd behavior, Callaghan said he found two highly obfuscated scripts. Together, they rendered a graph that analyzed the WebAudio readings of each visiting browser. This graph acted as an oscillator that measured Sawtooth waves , which are common in output from digital audio. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 中国零售商速卖通被发现对访问者进行指纹识别，因为其中一项指标（一种过时的技术，用于测量发送到浏览器的听不见的声音）阻碍了研究人员使用蓝牙耳机的能力。研究员马修·卡拉汉表示，他无意中发现了这种秘密跟踪。加载 AliExpress 主页后，他的多点耳机停止播放手机中的音频，该耳机一次接受来自多个设备的连接。他将耳机设置为播放手机中的声音，除非电脑正在产生音频。每次他加载全球速卖通时，手机音频就会停止。每次他关闭加载网站的选项卡时，手机就会再次响起。用户听不到它，但浏览器可以。在调查奇怪的行为时，卡拉汉说他发现了两个高度混淆的脚本。他们一起绘制了一个图表，分析每个访问浏览器的 WebAudio 读数。该图充当测量锯齿波的振荡器，锯齿波在数字音频的输出中很常见。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
title.zh: 总理表示，分享危险驾驶视频“确实应受到谴责”

summary.en: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The government has urged social media companies to remove posts celebrating dangerous driving, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham branded sharing them "truly reprehensible".

Earlier Defence Minister Luke Pollard told BBC Breakfast that "social media companies could take the content down easily and adjust their algorithms to stop it being distributed".

Two police officers died when a car going the wrong way down a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle near Middlesbrough on Saturday. Five passengers in the other car were also killed.

A TikTok account believed to belong to one of the five passengers, 18-year-old Makai Saddington, previously shared videos appearing to show dangerous driving, which have since been removed.

But Cleveland Police said "there is no evidence to indicate that filming of the activities that took place on Friday night and Saturday morning has taken place for the purposes of TikTok".

Pollard said the government had "already taken steps" to tell social media companies to take down such content.

He added: "They know exactly what content is on their site, they know how their algorithm works.

"They also know that people post content to get views and the more views you get, sometimes you get money for it, so it's a financial incentive to post outrageous content that gets more people watching it."

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Burnham said the people who share footage glorifying dangerous driving are "doing something that's truly reprehensible".

A Downing Street spokeswoman said "the glorification of dangerous driving for clips and entertainment is utterly disgraceful".

She added that the culture secretary has been clear that footage should be removed by social media platforms "in line with their legal obligations", and that Ofcom has the government's "full backing to take action" against those that fail in their duties.

Video content featuring illegal activity is not necessarily illegal itself - according to the Online Safety Act - it is up to the social network to decide whether flagged content is illegal and act accordingly.

TikTok said its policies prohibit content that could cause significant physical harm, including dangerous driving.

It added that it is actively removing videos and accounts that break its rules, including the account believed to belong to Saddington.

The company said between January and March 2026, 99.8% of the content removed for violating those policies it took down proactively.

While TikTok is taking some videos down, it is not necessarily because it has deemed them to be illegal - it may only be because they breach the firm's own terms and conditions.

There are specific exceptions which are set out in the Online Safety Act, but they can be difficult to interpret.

body.zh: 政府敦促社交媒体公司删除庆祝危险驾驶的帖子，总理安迪·伯纳姆称分享这些帖子“真正应受谴责”。 早些时候，国防部长卢克·波拉德 (Luke Pollard) 告诉 BBC 早餐会，“社交媒体公司可以轻松删除这些内容，并调整其算法以阻止其传播”。 周六，一辆在双车道上逆行的汽车在米德尔斯堡附近撞上了他们的车，两名警察死亡。另一辆车上的五名乘客也被杀。 据信，这五名乘客之一、18 岁的马凯·萨丁顿 (Makai Saddington) 的 TikTok 账户此前曾分享过看似危险驾驶的视频，但这些视频已被删除。 但克利夫兰警方表示，“没有证据表明周五晚上和周六早上发生的活动的拍摄是为了 TikTok 的目的”。 波拉德表示，政府“已经采取措施”要求社交媒体公司删除此类内容。 他补充道：“他们确切地知道他们网站上有什么内容，他们知道他们的算法是如何工作的。 “他们还知道，人们发布内容是为了获得观看次数，获得的观看次数越多，有时你就能获得金钱，因此发布令人震惊的内容以吸引更多人观看是一种经济激励。” 伯纳姆在基辅对记者表示，那些分享美化危险驾驶视频的人“正在做真正应受谴责的事情”。 唐宁街发言人表示，“为了剪辑和娱乐而美化危险驾驶是完全可耻的”。 她补充说，文化大臣已经明确表示，社交媒体平台应“根据其法律义务”删除视频，并且 Ofcom 得到政府“全力支持对那些不履行职责的人采取行动”。 具有非法活动的视频内容本身不一定是非法的 - 根据《在线安全法》 - 由社交网络决定标记的内容是否非法并采取相应行动。 TikTok 表示，其政策禁止发布可能造成严重人身伤害的内容，包括危险驾驶。 它补充说，它正在积极删除违反其规则的视频和帐户，包括据信属于萨丁顿的帐户。 该公司表示，2026 年 1 月至 3 月期间，99.8% 的内容因违反其主动删除的政策而被删除。 虽然 TikTok 下架了一些视频，但这并不一定是因为它认为这些视频非法，而可能只是因为它们违反了公司自己的条款和条件。 《在线安全法》中规定了一些特定的例外情况，但它们可能很难解释。 例如，内容...

title.en: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
title.zh: Twitch 和亚马逊因使用直播训练人工智能而面临法律诉讼

summary.en: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit , external over its move to train its AI models on videos people broadcast on the popular streaming platform Twitch.

The move faced backlash from users when it was announced in August - with people having the option to opt-out if they do not want their data used this way.

The class action lawsuit has been brought on behalf of millions of streamers who use Twitch, alleging its parent company Amazon used their videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.

Streamers on the platform reportedly produced , external more than 215 million hours of content in the first few months of 2026 alone.

It claims Twitch breached its contract with users by using that content as AI training data for Amazon's models without obtaining their permission.

It adds streamers should not have their work commercially exploited to develop AI without consent or compensation.

The lawsuit seeks damages for streamers whose content was allegedly used to train AI, as well as an order preventing Amazon from continuing the alleged practice.

It is not clear when Amazon began collecting Twitch users' data to train its AI models.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton previously said he did not know if users' data had been scraped for training before it gave people the opportunity to opt-out.

He said he was unsure what Amazon "has done in terms of model training and what they've used and not used".

In Twitch's own FAQs about AI training, it said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text".

It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Those that want to disable the feature would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

However, the opt-out only applies to individual streams, meaning creators' content could still be used for AI training when they appear in a stream where the feature remains enabled.

Amazon, which bought Twitch for nearly $1bn (£740m) in 2014, has made AI a major focus as it competes with Google, Meta and other tech giants.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 亚马逊因在热门流媒体平台 Twitch 上播放的视频上训练其人工智能模型而面临外部诉讼。 此举在 8 月份宣布时遭到了用户的强烈反对，如果人们不希望自己的数据以这种方式使用，他们可以选择退出。 该集体诉讼是代表数百万使用 Twitch 的主播提起的，指控其母公司亚马逊在未经许可或适当补偿的情况下使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。 据报道，仅 2026 年前几个月，该平台上的流媒体就制作了超过 2.15 亿小时的内容。 它声称 Twitch 在未经用户许可的情况下将这些内容用作亚马逊模型的人工智能训练数据，违反了与用户的合同。 它还补充说，未经同意或补偿，主播不应将其作品用于商业用途以开发人工智能。 该诉讼要求对内容据称被用来训练人工智能的流媒体造成损害，并要求下令阻止亚马逊继续其所谓的做法。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊何时开始收集 Twitch 用户数据来训练其人工智能模型。 Twitch 的首席产品官迈克·明顿 (Mike Minton) 此前表示，他不知道用户的数据是否已被抓取用于培训，然后才给人们选择退出的机会。 他表示，他不确定亚马逊“在模型训练方面做了什么，以及他们使用了什么和没有使用什么”。 在 Twitch 自己的关于人工智能训练的常见问题解答中，它表示一个人的音频可能会被用来“改进创建语音到文本的模型”。 该公司表示，这将有助于改进 Twitch 流媒体和亚马逊视频的自动字幕。 想要禁用该功能的用户需要导航到 Streamer 仪表板中的“设置”选项卡，单击“安全和隐私”选项卡，然后向下滚动到选项底部附近并关闭“生成 AI 训练”。 然而，选择退出仅适用于单个流，这意味着当创作者的内容出现在该功能保持启用的流中时，仍然可以用于人工智能训练。 亚马逊于 2014 年以近 10 亿美元（7.4 亿英镑）的价格收购了 Twitch，在与谷歌、Meta 和其他科技巨头竞争时，已将人工智能作为主要焦点。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

title.en: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
title.zh: TikTok因侵犯儿童隐私被罚款4亿美元，创下最大规模和解案之一

summary.en: TikTok has agreed to pay $400 million to the US to settle a lawsuit accusing the platform and its parent company, ByteDance, of illegally collecting extensive data from millions of users under 13, violating the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act.
summary.zh: TikTok已同意向美国支付4亿美元，以了结一项指控该平台及其母公司字节跳动非法收集数百万13岁以下用户大量数据的诉讼，此举违反了《儿童在线隐私保护法》。

body.en:
TikTok has agreed to pay $400m (£293m) to the US to end a lawsuit alleging its platform violated children‘s privacy, marking one of the largest ever settlements over the issue.

The deal stems from a 2024 suit by the Department of Justice under former President Joe Biden alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

Doing so was against the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), a federal law enacted in 2000. It is the same law that dozens of US states are now suing Meta over .

"Children and parents are better protected today than they were when this case began," assistant Attorney General Brett Shumate said.

Other companies to have paid penalties to the US government for COPPA violations include Google's YouTube, which in 2019 paid $170m, and Epic Games, which in 2022 paid $275m.

Meta is also now facing penalties that could exceed hundreds of billions of dollars stemming from COPPA violations alleged by attorneys general of 29 US states. A jury trial in the lawsuit started this week , with the Instagram and Facebook owner accused of targeting child users and profiting from them.

While the TikTok lawsuit predates last year's split of TikTok's US business and operations from its original base of China, the settlement only involves TikTok's operations in China.

ByteDance, which is a privately held company, was most recently valued by investors at $550bn , external .

Under the terms of the deal, TikTok and ByteDance will immediately pay the DOJ $300m. It will pay another $100m when the government vacates a 2019 consent decree , external with the Federal Trade Commission.

As part of the agreement, the predecessor to ByteDance, Musical.ly, was required to pay a $5.7m fine for COPPA violations and ensure it sought parental consent for any user aged under 13.

The justice department did not detail on Friday any action against TikTok beyond the fine. But the department noted that since it sued the platform, TikTok has "undergone significant changes," including to its ownership, privacy practices and platform controls for young users.

When the lawsuit was filed, attorneys for the US said there were more than 170 million teenagers using TikTok and that the app was "directed to children." Yet, it did not effectively gauge the age of users or get parental consent for use from those underage.

In 2024, former President Biden pushed for TikTok to be either banned, or have the company divest its US operations. President Donald Trump went on to support divestment of the app, which occurred last year.

Its US operations are now 81% owned by a consortium of investors, while Bytedance maintains a 19% stake.
body.zh: TikTok 同意向美国支付 4 亿美元（2.93 亿英镑），以结束指控其平台侵犯儿童隐私的诉讼，这是该问题有史以来最大的和解协议之一。 该交易源于前总统乔·拜登领导下的司法部于 2024 年提起的诉讼，指控 TikTok 及其母公司字节跳动收集了数百万 13 岁以下用户的“大量数据”。 这样做违反了 2000 年颁布的联邦法律《儿童在线隐私保护法》(COPPA)。美国数十个州现在正在通过同一法律起诉 Meta。 助理司法部长布雷特·舒马特说：“与此案开始时相比，今天的儿童和家长得到了更好的保护。” 其他因违反 COPPA 行为而向美国政府支付罚款的公司包括谷歌旗下的 YouTube（2019 年支付了 1.7 亿美元）和 Epic Games（2022 年支付了 2.75 亿美元）。 美国 29 个州总检察长指控 Meta 因违反 COPPA 规定而面临可能超过数千亿美元的处罚。该诉讼的陪审团审判于本周开始，Instagram 和 Facebook 所有者被指控针对儿童用户并从中获利。 虽然 TikTok 诉讼早于去年 TikTok 的美国业务和业务从其原来的中国基地剥离出来，但和解协议仅涉及 TikTok 在中国的业务。 字节跳动是一家私营公司，最近投资者的外部估值为 5500 亿美元。 根据交易条款，TikTok 和字节跳动将立即向司法部支付 3 亿美元。当政府撤销 2019 年联邦贸易委员会的同意令时，它将再支付 1 亿美元。 作为协议的一部分，字节跳动的前身 Musical.ly 需要因违反 COPPA 规定而支付 570 万美元的罚款，并确保其为所有 13 岁以下的用户征求家长的同意。 周五，除了罚款之外，司法部没有详细说明针对 TikTok 采取的任何行动。但该部门指出，自起诉该平台以来，TikTok“经历了重大变化”，包括其所有权、隐私做法和对年轻用户的平台控制。 提起诉讼时，美国律师表示，有超过 1.7 亿青少年使用 TikTok，并且该应用程序“针对儿童”。然而，它并没有有效地衡量用户的年龄，也没有获得未成年人使用的父母同意。 2024 年，前总统拜登推动禁止 TikTok，或者让该公司剥离其美国业务。唐纳德·特朗普总统继续支持去年撤资该应用程序。 其美国业务目前由一个投资者财团持有 81% 的股份，而字节跳动则保留 19% 的股份。

reflection.en: This settlement highlights a critical need to protect the privacy of children, who are often unable to advocate for themselves in the digital world. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for everyone who isליך to be silenced." This principle applies directly to safeguarding young users from data exploitation.
reflection.zh: 这项和解案凸显了保护儿童隐私的迫切需要，因为他们在数字世界中常常无法为自己发声。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们：“为不能说话的辩护，为所有被定罪的人辩护。”这一原则直接适用于保护年轻用户免受数据剥削。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How landscape gardening is being electrified
title.zh: 园林景观如何电气化

summary.en: The switch to quieter electric equipment is not going as fast as some would like.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Part of the soundtrack to a day in southern California is the drone of petrol-powered gardening equipment.

Noise is one of the main reasons that cities around the US , external are banning petrol landscaping tools or encouraging electric alternatives.

These alternatives have the additional benefits of reducing carbon emissions, vibrations and the exposure of landscapers to pollution.

In addition they can mean longer working hours, as they can be used at times when residents demand quiet.

Today, I'm taking part in training run by the American Green Zone Alliance (AGZA), an organisation supporting the transition towards electric landscaping equipment.

To my surprise, the electric backpack leaf blower I strap on is not much heavier than my normal rucksack. Using the blower to herd balls around the park feels fairly intuitive, though naturally I'm much clumsier and slower than the pro landscapers.

As for noise, there's still a buzz, but the sound is higher-pitched and not quite so loud as the familiar petrol-powered machines.

The move to electric power is attracting new companies to the market for gardening kit.

US aerospace start-up Whisper Aero is one of those firms. Its main business is electric propulsion systems for aircraft.

But in 2022, after the Covid-19 pandemic made many people more sensitive to noise, and following a couple of years of research and development, the company realised that its aerospace-grade fans would work well in leaf blowers.

"Our technology is cleaner, quieter and more efficient than other air-moving technologies that exist today," according to Andrew Terajewicz, Whisper Aero's director of air management. "And the leaf blower is the perfect mix of this."

The company has had to scale up its manufacturing volume in its expansion to consumer technology.

Online pre-orders of Whisper Aero's handheld leaf blower started this year. It's priced at the high-end of electric leaf blowers, which are often more expensive than traditional petrol versions.

"It is so ultra quiet yet powerful, that the brain has a hard time understanding what's happening," says Dan Mabe, the former landscaper who founded AGZA.

Whisper Aero aims to further develop its products, including a backpack leaf blower that would be better suited to professional landscapers.

Even with innovation like that, petrol-powered machines are unlikely to disappear anytime soon, particularly for professional landscapers.

For a start, petrol machines are much more powerful, which makes for quicker work, so less time is spent lugging around heavy equipment.

Terajewicz says that heavy-duty petrol backpack blowers can reach a maximum blowing force of about 50 newtons.

title.en: DNA analysis of Asiatic wild dogs scat in India reveals wild prey preference
title.zh: 印度亚洲野狗粪便的 DNA 分析揭示了野生猎物的偏好

summary.en: Endangered Asiatic wild dogs in central India almost entirely eat wild prey, even where they overlap with livestock, according to a recent study. The findings show that maintaining healthy wild prey populations is key to conserving the species, reports contributor Rajeev Tyagi...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Endangered Asiatic wild dogs in central India almost entirely eat wild prey, even where they overlap with livestock, according to a recent study. The findings show that maintaining healthy wild prey populations is key to conserving the species, reports contributor Rajeev Tyagi for Mongabay India. The study, led by the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) in Bengaluru and the Maharashtra Forest Department, analyzed the feces or scat of dholes or Asiatic wild dogs (Cuon alpinus) inside the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in the state of Maharashtra. Instead of scooping up entire piles of dhole scat, forest staff and researchers collected only small pinches of material during the monsoon and winter of 2022-2023. Researchers then used a method called DNA metabarcoding to analyze what the dholes had eaten. It’s a technique that extracts genetic material from fecal samples and matches it against a massive reference database containing information from tens of thousands of species. Traditional methods for analyzing carnivore diets rely on microhistology — examining prey hairs found in animal feces of scat under a microscope. But this method is vulnerable to observer bias, said study co-author and molecular ecologist Abhinav Tyagi. “Different people can categorise hair differently, and it induces a human or an observer’s bias,” Tyagi said. Arjun Srivathsa, a wildlife biologist affiliated with the Wildlife Conservation Society – India and not involved in the study, said that traditional methods are also prone to errors like misidentification of species or non-detection of certain species. title.en: Two planned datacentres will have higher UK carbon emissions than ExxonMobil, analysis finds
title.zh: 分析发现，两个计划中的数据中心的英国碳排放量将高于埃克森美孚

summary.en: Exclusive: Buckinghamshire and Bedfordshire sites predicted to emit 4.5m tonnes a year when fully running The carbon emissions from just two planned datacentres in England will exceed all of the fossil fuel company ExxonMobil’s UK emissions, analysis has revealed. Experts have...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Exclusive: Buckinghamshire and Bedfordshire sites predicted to emit 4.5m tonnes a year when fully running

The carbon emissions from just two planned datacentres in England will exceed all of the fossil fuel company ExxonMobil’s UK emissions, analysis has revealed.

Experts have said this demonstrates the “serious threat” datacentres pose to the UK’s legally binding climate goals.

Analysis by the non-profit group Foxglove reveals that when fully operational, the Wapseys Wood datacentre in Buckinghamshire and the Quest Park datacentre in Bedfordshire will use 1.3GW of power and will produce more than 4.5m tonnes of carbon emissions.

ExxonMobil emitted 3.9m tonnes in 2023, according to the global energy thinktank Ember.

AI datacentres use a massive amount of electricity to power servers and cooling equipment, and to run facility systems. There are currently 315 datacentres in the queue to connect to the UK’s electricity grid, representing 73GW of demand. This is almost double the peak winter energy demand for the entire UK.

Because of the long wait to connect to the grid, the Wapseys Wood and Quest Park datacentres are seeking to build their own on-site gas-fired power stations.

Based on government figures on the carbon intensity of electricity generation, Foxglove has calculated these projects will produce 4.577m tonnes of carbon emissions per year.

A government spokesperson said these figures were “misleading” because of the assumption that both projects will run at 100% utilisation from day one, which they said was “not accurate”.

Tom Hegarty, head of communications at Foxglove, said assuming a 100% utilisation rate followed standard industry practice.

Kierra Box, a trade and environmental regulation campaigner at Friends of the Earth, said the aim was for datacentres to increase load and run at full capacity, and so it was “valid to look at those top level predictions”.

The former England and Wales Green party leader Caroline Lucas described the projected emissions from these projects as “absolutely horrifying”, and said it should be ringing alarm bells right across government.

The government says its own analysis shows there are multiple pathways for this rapid datacentre rollout to fit within the seventh carbon budget , which sets out how the government will reach its international climate targets.

Toby Perkins, a Labour MP and chair of the Commons environmental audit committee, which is leading an inquiry into the environmental impact of datacentres, said this analysis was a “potent reminder that without the right measures in place, data centres could represent a serious threat to the environment and to our legally binding climate goals”.

title.en: Bomb Fishing Is Wreaking Havoc on Indonesia's Coral Reefs
title.zh: 炸弹捕鱼对印度尼西亚的珊瑚礁造成严重破坏

summary.en: Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.” Read more on E360 →
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Inside Climate News and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”

Nicknamed the “Amazon of the Seas,” the Coral Triangle is the world’s most biologically diverse marine ecosystem. Sink below the surface and you’ll encounter the sound of a vibrant symphony of snapping shrimp, crunching crustaceans, and feeding fish.

But then the rhythmic music of life will dissolve into eerie silence, punctured only by the plosive boom of detonating bombs.

Off the coast of Indonesia’s Spermonde Archipelago, underwater microphones captured over 3,500 explosions in just 3,600 hours of recording, according to researchers from the Zoological Society of London.

The source? Blast fishing — a globally banned technique that uses plastic bottles packed with explosives to stun and kill everything in a 90-foot radius. The highly destructive practice has been documented in at least 34 countries, from Lebanon and Libya to Brazil and Ecuador.

While fishers predominantly use the method to catch fish for sale at local markets — identifiable by their ruptured internal organs and burst swim bladders — it’s also a grave threat to colorful coral reef habitats.

“Bomb fishing is quite likely the leading cause of reef loss in this area,” said Ben Williams, the paper’s lead author, noting that a single bomb can wreak 200 square feet of destruction. “These picturesque reefs get converted into a landscape that looks like the moon. It’s just rubble and dead coral with very little sign of life.”

In 2023, researchers from Britain and Indonesia snorkeled down and anchored $150 audio recorders to short stakes in the seafloor. Using A.I. software — which the team has now made open-source — they scoured 16 months of audio in just a few hours to identify possible detonations.

While the A.I. filtered suspected cases, each suggested sound wave was then manually verified to assess if it stemmed from a bomb or a misfiring boat engine.

With sound traveling over four times faster through water than air, the team of marine scientists were able to detect detonations from over 10 miles away.

“When [the bombs] are close, it’s so loud that it can shake you out of your skin,” said Williams. “But if you put your head up on the surface, you probably can’t even see the boat that did it.”

Accounting for stormy-season setbacks and spearfishermen who tampered with the recorders, the team calculated that there were likely more than 8,500 blasts each year — all within an area of just 350 square miles.

body.en: JAKARTA — A new study of palm oil concessions linked to Indonesian supply chains finds no evidence that corporate zero-deforestation commitments have led to additional reductions in deforestation. Tropical countries such as Indonesia continue to lose their forests at an alarming pace. In 2025, the world lost 4.3 million hectares of tropical primary forest, equivalent to more than 11 football fields of forest a minute . To curb this trend, palm oil-producing countries have introduced national policies in the past decade, while companies have increasingly adopted zero-deforestation commitments (ZDCs). When viewed through a before-and-after lens, Indonesian palm oil ZDCs appear highly successful at reducing deforestation. To determine how effective these commitments actually are, an international team of researchers compared deforestation trends in Indonesia’s palm oil sector — the world’s largest producer and exporter of the commodity — between concessions linked to supply chains with ZDCs and those without them. Using public databases to identify companies that have adopted ZDCs, the study, published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS), found that companies had largely complied with their commitments. However, it found no evidence that those commitments produced an additional reduction in deforestation in Indonesian palm-oil concessions beyond broader changes affecting the sector. In both ZDC-linked and non-ZDC concessions, the study says, . During the full implementation period for ZDCs from 2018 to 2020, annualized deforestation fell to around 0.5% in both groups. summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Keiko Sofía Fujimori Higuchi from the Popular Force Party was sworn in as the new president of Peru on July 28. Fujimori, who has pledged to tackle insecurity using greater force and militarization, narrowly defeated her left-wing opponent Roberto Sánchez by fewer than 50,000 votes on June 7. The new president has promised to expand fossil fuel production and mining across the country, raising concerns among environmentalists and Indigenous leaders about the future of the Peruvian Amazon, as well as its international commitments to reduce greenhouse gas emissions through its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) — a national climate action plan under the Paris Agreement. The country submitted its first NDC in 2016, which was then updated in 2020 and 2025. In its plan, it has committed to diversify renewable energy sources, strengthen sustainable transportation, reduce deforestation, protect natural areas and support Indigenous and local communities, among other mitigation priorities. Experts, environmentalists and Indigenous leaders expressed concerns about the government’s plans, particularly Fujimori’s promise to expand the exploration and exploitation of energy resources, such as the promotion of new lots in the Amazon and the northern coast. Peru’s President Keiko Fujimori, center, poses for a group photo with members of her cabinet at the government palace in Lima, Peru, Tuesday, July 28, 2026. (AP Photo/Guadalupe Pardo) “The current government is a bit pragmatic in its decisions because they are really driven by wanting development without considering the consequences for the Amazonian peoples,” Matsés Indigenous leader Leo Chuma Teca Beso told Mongabay…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 来自人民力量党的藤森惠子 (Keiko Sofía Fujimori Higuchi) 于 7 月 28 日宣誓就任秘鲁新总统。藤森承诺使用更大的武力和军事化来解决不安全问题，并于 6 月 7 日以不到 5 万票的微弱优势击败了左翼对手罗伯托·桑切斯 (Roberto Sánchez)。新总统承诺扩大全国范围内的化石燃料生产和采矿，引起了环保人士和原住民领袖对秘鲁未来的担忧。秘鲁亚马逊，以及通过其国家自主贡献（NDC）（《巴黎协定》下的国家气候行动计划）减少温室气体排放的国际承诺。该国于 2016 年提交了第一份国家自主贡献，并于 2020 年和 2025 年进行了更新。在其计划中，该国致力于实现可再生能源多样化、加强可持续交通、减少森林砍伐、保护自然区域以及支持原住民和当地社区以及其他缓解优先事项。专家、环保人士和原住民领袖对政府的计划表示担忧，特别是藤森承诺扩大能源资源的勘探和开发，例如在亚马逊和北部海岸推广新地块。秘鲁总统藤森庆子（中）于 2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二在秘鲁利马政府宫与内阁成员合影。（美联社照片/瓜达卢佩·帕尔多）“现任政府的决定有点务实，因为他们实际上是为了发展而没有考虑到亚马逊人民的后果，”马塞斯土著领袖利奥·丘马·特卡·贝索 (Leo Chuma Teca Beso) 告诉 Mongabay……本文最初发表在枇杷湾

title.en: Bogong moths support Australia’s alpine ecosystems, but face uncertain future
title.zh: 博贡蛾支持澳大利亚高山生态系统，但面临不确定的未来

summary.en: At first glance, Australia’s bogong moth is a decidedly unspectacular-looking creature. The moths are typically a dark, mottled brown and each weighs less than a Tic Tac mint or half a gram. But looks can be deceiving. Every spring in the Southern Hemisphere, from September to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: At first glance, Australia’s bogong moth is a decidedly unspectacular-looking creature. The moths are typically a dark, mottled brown and each weighs less than a Tic Tac mint or half a gram. But looks can be deceiving. Every spring in the Southern Hemisphere, from September to November, billions of bogong moths (Agrotis infusa) undertake an epic journey. Using the stars and the Earth’s magnetic field, these tiny insects navigate hundreds of kilometers across Australia. Their destination is the Australian Alps, located in the far southeast corner of the country, where they will shelter in cool caves for the duration of the summer. The moths are a critical resource for the many rare and wonderful species that live in these mountains. “The whole [alpine] zone relies on the bogong moths,” said Marissa Parrott, a senior conservation biologist at Zoos Victoria. “They’re the second largest influx of nutrients into the Alps every year, beaten only by the sun.” But the moth’s future is far from certain. Their numbers have been slowly declining since the 1980s, and in 2017, populations crashed, likely due to extreme drought across much of southeastern Australia. A bogong moth in Sydney. Image by John Tann via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0). At several locations, cave walls that had once been densely blanketed with moths — several thousand occupying each square meter (equivalent to 11 square feet) — were all but empty. “They went from four billion to nearly undetectable,” Parrott said. The population collapse threatens the alpine ecosystem,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 乍一看，澳大利亚的博贡蛾是一种长相毫不起眼的生物。这些飞蛾通常是深褐色、有斑点的棕色，每只的重量还不到 Tic Tac 薄荷糖或半克。但外表可能具有欺骗性。每年春天，从 9 月到 11 月，南半球的数十亿只小地老虎 (Agrotis infusa) 都会展开一场史诗般的旅程。利用恒星和地球磁场，这些微小的昆虫在澳大利亚航行数百公里。他们的目的地是位于该国东南角的澳大利亚阿尔卑斯山，他们将在那里的凉爽洞穴中度过整个夏天。对于生活在这些山区的许多稀有而奇妙的物种来说，飞蛾是重要的资源。 “整个（高山）地区都依赖于博贡蛾，”维多利亚动物园的高级保护生物学家玛丽莎·帕罗特（Marissa Parrott）说。 “它们是每年流入阿尔卑斯山的第二大营养物质，仅次于太阳。”但飞蛾的未来还远未确定。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，它们的数量一直在缓慢下降，2017 年，数量锐减，可能是由于澳大利亚东南部大部分地区的极端干旱。悉尼的一只博贡蛾。图片由 John Tann 提供，来自 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）。在一些地方，曾经密布飞蛾的洞穴墙壁——每平方米（相当于 11 平方英尺）有数千只飞蛾——现在几乎空无一人。 “它们从 40 亿增加到几乎无法检测到，”帕罗特说。人口锐减威胁着高山生态系统，……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Sydney shark attack survivor describes moment she came to face-to-face with ‘monster’
title.zh: 悉尼鲨鱼袭击幸存者描述与“怪兽”面对面的时刻

summary.en: Leah Stewart, a 34-year-old mother and teacher, shared her first interview after losing an arm in a shark attack at Sydney's Coogee Beach in June. She recalled that during the terrifying encounter, her primary thoughts were of her one-year-old daughter, which helped her endure the ordeal.
summary.zh: 34岁的教师兼母亲利亚·斯图尔特（Leah Stewart）在6月悉尼库吉海滩的鲨鱼袭击中失去了一只手臂，近日她接受了首次媒体采访。她回忆起那次恐怖的遭遇，称在被咬时她心中唯一的念头就是自己一岁的女儿，这支撑着她度过了难关。

body.en: In her first media interview since the June incident, Leah Stewart, 34, says her thoughts while being bitten were of her one-year-old daughter An Australian woman who lost an arm after a shark attack at a beach in Sydney’s eastern suburbs has recalled the moment she came face-to-face with the “monster”. Leah Stewart, a 34-year-old teacher and mother of a one-year-old daughter, was attacked by a large shark while on a morning swim at Coogee beach on 13 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 34 岁的莉亚·斯图尔特 (Leah Stewart) 在 6 月事件发生后首次接受媒体采访时表示，在被咬伤时，她的脑海里浮现的是自己一岁的女儿。 一名澳大利亚妇女在悉尼东郊海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后失去了一只手臂，她回忆起自己与“怪物”面对面的那一刻。 6 月 13 日，34 岁的教师 Leah Stewart 是一名一岁女儿的母亲，她在库吉海滩晨泳时遭到大鲨鱼袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the terrifying silence of a life-threatening crisis, our deepest loves often become our strongest anchors. Leah Stewart’s focus on her young daughter during the attack reminds us that even in the darkest 'valleys,' the bonds of family provide a profound reason to persevere. We pray for her continued physical and emotional healing as she navigates life...
reflection.zh: 在生命受到威胁的恐怖寂静中，我们最深沉的爱往往成为最坚固的锚。利亚·斯图尔特在遭受袭击时对幼女的牵挂提醒我们，即使在最黑暗的“幽谷”中，家庭的纽带也能提供坚持下去的深刻动力。我们为她在经历如此创伤后的身体和情感康复祈祷，愿雅伟在悲剧后的余波中与她同在。

title.en: In Raja Ampat, children learn that their knowledge can help protect their islands
title.zh: 在拉惹安帕，孩子们学会用知识保护他们的岛屿

summary.en: Children in Arborek, Raja Ampat, are learning about their local environment and the threats it faces, such as nickel mining, through children's books. Their ability to identify various marine species highlights a deep connection to and understanding of their surroundings.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚西巴布亚的阿博雷克岛上，孩子们通过儿童读物学习当地环境及其面临的威胁，如镍矿开采。他们能够识别各种海洋生物，这表明了他们对周围环境的深刻联系和理解。

body.en: ARBOREK, West Papua, Indonesia — “Rockhead fish, salamander fish, starfish and coral.” That’s what dozens of children from Arborek, a small island in Indonesia’s Raja Ampat archipelago, said when asked what they see in nature that is yellow and orange. The children rattled off the fish and other marine life they encounter when they play in the sea, during a reading of a children’s book about Raja Ampat and the threat of nickel mining. A coral reef and marine life in the waters off Raja Ampat in Southwest Papua province, Indonesia. Image courtesy of Econusa. Research suggests that children who grow up closely connected to their surroundings can develop sophisticated understandings of their local environment. A 2014 study of children in 22 villages in Indonesian Borneo, for example, found that they recognized relationships among forests, rivers, wildlife and other environmental changes. So Sekar Bestari, the book’s illustrator, wasn’t surprised by the children’s answers. “Most of the time when we read the books to children, they understand them, so don’t underestimate children’s knowledge,” she said after the reading in Arborek. “We’re not surprised anymore today.” The reading was part of a three-day gathering of Indigenous communities in Arborek that brought together representatives from 20 Indigenous subtribes in Raja Ampat, as well as Indigenous people from other parts of Indonesia and abroad. The gathering, organized by Greenpeace Indonesia and local NGO Institut USBA, was intended to strengthen solidarity among Indigenous communities in protecting their lands, waters and biodiversity. The children’s knowledge of…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚西巴布亚阿博雷克 — “岩头鱼、蝾螈鱼、海星和珊瑚。”当被问及他们在大自然中看到的黄色和橙色是什么时，来自印度尼西亚拉贾安帕群岛小岛阿伯雷克的数十名孩子是这么说的。孩子们一边阅读一本有关拉贾安帕和镍矿开采威胁的儿童读物，一边滔滔不绝地讲述他们在海里玩耍时遇到的鱼类和其他海洋生物。印度尼西亚西南部巴布亚省四王群岛附近海域的珊瑚礁和海洋生物。图片由伊科努萨提供。研究表明，在成长过程中与周围环境密切相关的孩子可以对当地环境有更深入的了解。例如，2014 年对印度尼西亚婆罗洲 22 个村庄的儿童进行的一项研究发现，他们认识到森林、河流、野生动物和其他环境变化之间的关系。因此，这本书的插画家 Sekar Bestari 对孩子们的回答并不感到惊讶。 “大多数时候，当我们给孩子们读书时，他们都能理解，所以不要低估孩子们的知识，”她在 Arborek 读书后说道。 “今天我们不再感到惊讶了。”此次朗读活动是 Arborek 为期三天的原住民社区聚会的一部分，该聚会聚集了来自四王群岛 20 个原住民社区的代表，以及来自印度尼西亚其他地区和国外的原住民。这次聚会由印度尼西亚绿色和平组织和当地非政府组织 USBA 研究所组织，旨在加强原住民社区在保护其土地、水域和生物多样性方面的团结。孩子们的知识……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The children of Arborek, by naming the "rockhead fish, salamander fish, starfish and coral" they see, embody the Psalmist's observation that creation is "full of your riches." Their intimate knowledge of the sea is a testament to the wisdom inherent in the natural world, a wisdom that can inspire care and protection for their island home.
reflection.zh: 阿博雷克岛的孩子们通过说出他们看到的“岩头鱼、蝾螈鱼、海星和珊瑚”，体现了诗篇作者关于“遍地满了你的财富”的观察。他们对海洋的深刻了解证明了自然界固有的智慧，这种智慧可以激发他们对家园岛屿的关爱和保护。

body.en: Peter J McKosky celebrates the return of the river otter after a century to New York, but notes that hundreds are violently killed in traps every year elsewhere in the state Your report on the river otter’s return to New York City’s Bronx River after a century’s absence ( 19 August ) is genuinely wonderful news – proof that patient ecological restoration works. But it sits uneasily alongside a fact rarely mentioned: New York state still permits the trapping and killing of hundreds of river otters every year, purely for recreation. State wildlife data shows an average annual toll of around 900 otters , sometimes over 1,100, killed in body-gripping and leg-hold traps designed to crush, hold, drown or kill by force. Otters are recognised as an indicator species – their presence signals genuine ecosystem health. There is no overpopulation crisis and, with the fur trade in serious decline, barely an economic rationale left. What remains is the recreational interest of a small minority of trappers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 彼得·J·麦科斯基 (Peter J McKosky) 庆祝河獭在一个世纪后重返纽约，但他指出，在该州其他地方，每年都有数百只河獭在陷阱中被暴力杀害。您关于河獭在缺席一个世纪后重返纽约市布朗克斯河的报告（8 月 19 日）确实是一个好消息，证明耐心的生态恢复是有效的。但它与一个很少被提及的事实令人不安：纽约州每年仍然允许捕获和杀死数百只水獭，纯粹是为了娱乐。州野生动物数据显示，每年平均有约 900 只水獭（有时超过 1,100 只）死于旨在压碎、抓住、淹死或强行杀死的夹体和夹腿陷阱。水獭被认为是指示物种——它们的存在标志着真正的生态系统健康。不存在人口过剩危机，而且随着毛皮贸易的严重下滑，几乎没有任何经济理由可言。剩下的只是少数捕猎者的娱乐兴趣。继续阅读...

body.en: The conservationist Harry Green was a naturalist of the amateur school, with an encyclopedic knowledge of British wildlife based on a lifetime in the field. Though born and brought up in Oxfordshire, he spent the whole of his adult life in his adopted county of Worcestershire. Harry, who has died aged 92, remembered being kept awake during the second world war by calling corncrakes in the meadows near his home. Later he strove, against the odds, to save Britain’s last colony of marsh warblers near Pershore. These, and the corncrakes, eventually vanished, but other species, such as hobbies, little egrets and Cetti’s warblers, did arrive and thrive. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自然资源保护主义者哈里·格林（Harry Green）是一位业余博物学家，凭借在该领域的一生，对英国野生动物有了百科全书式的了解。尽管他在牛津郡出生和长大，但他的整个成年生活都是在他收养的伍斯特郡度过的。已去世 92 岁的哈利记得，在第二次世界大战期间，他因在家附近的草地上叫玉米秧鸡而无法入睡。后来，他克服重重困难，努力拯救英国珀肖尔附近最后的沼泽莺群。这些鸟和玉米秧鸡最终消失了，但其他物种，如白鹭、小白鹭和塞蒂莺，确实出现并繁衍生息。继续阅读...

title.en: One of the World's ‘Most Wanted’ Lost Fish Is Rediscovered
title.zh: 世界上最想要的一种丢失的鱼被重新发现

summary.en: On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it had gone extinct.

On an expedition that unfolded like a search for a missing person, researchers spent two weeks traversing the Sepik River and its tributaries, scouring villages and markets for evidence of the missing pipefish. They showed its photo to fishers, vendors, and village elders and asked where it might be found.

The task was daunting. The Sepik River extends across 700 miles of forests, floodplains, and wetlands along the northern coast of Papua New Guinea. “Travel is almost entirely by motorized boat or canoe, often taking many hours between villages,” said Jerrica Agebigo of the New Guinea Binatang Research Centre. The vast scale of the river system meant that scientists were heavily reliant on local knowledge.

In interviews, villagers consistently reported spotting a long, slender fish in the shallows of the Sepik River. Though they called the fish many names — Karuweng , Inap , Karuwena , Sako — their descriptions matched the profile of the missing species.

In the final days of the expedition, a fisher named Helen Asu managed to nab two pipefish using the handheld net she relied on to catch prawns. Researchers shared photos of her catch with Australian ichthyologist Gerald Allen, one of the last researchers to document the spinach pipefish in the 1980s. He confirmed the rediscovery.

“It makes my heart sing to hear that the spinach pipefish has been recorded anew,” said marine biologist Amanda Vincent, who chairs an expert group on seahorses, pipefishes, and seadragons for the International Union for Conservation of Nature. “To learn that the spinach pipefish still exists gives us hope that other ‘lost’ species are out there, too.”

The spinach pipefish had been named one of the 10 “most wanted” lost freshwater fish species by SHOAL, a U.K. conservation group. Its rediscovery highlights the urgency of protecting freshwater fish, the group said.

In interviews throughout the expedition, villagers reported declines of native fish, which are imperiled by mining, logging, and other threats. Globally, freshwater fish are under growing pressure. A recent U.N. report found that over the last half-century, populations of migratory freshwater fish have declined by 81 percent.
body.zh: 在流经巴布亚新几内亚丛林的广阔河流网络中，研究人员重新发现了菠菜尖嘴鱼，它是海马的近亲，这种鱼已有 40 多年没有记录。这种鱼长期以来一直受到自然资源保护者的追捧，他们担心它已经灭绝。 在一次像寻找失踪人员一样展开的探险中，研究人员花了两周时间穿越塞皮克河及其支流，在村庄和市场中搜寻失踪海龙鱼的证据。他们向渔民、商贩和村长展示了它的照片，并询问在哪里可以找到它。 这项任务是艰巨的。塞皮克河沿着巴布亚新几内亚北部海岸绵延 700 英里，穿过森林、洪泛区和湿地。新几内亚比纳唐研究中心的杰里卡·阿格比戈 (Jerrica Agebigo) 说：“旅行几乎完全依靠机动船或独木舟，在村庄之间通常需要花费很多小时。”河流系统规模庞大，意味着科学家严重依赖当地知识。 在采访中，村民们一致表示在塞皮克河的浅滩上发现了一条细长的鱼。尽管他们给这种鱼起了很多名字——Karuweng、Inap、Karuwena、Sako——但他们的描述与失踪物种的概况相符。 在探险的最后几天，一位名叫海伦·阿苏的渔民用她用来捕虾的手持网成功捕获了两条海龙。研究人员与澳大利亚鱼类学家杰拉尔德·艾伦 (Gerald Allen) 分享了她捕获的照片，杰拉尔德·艾伦是 20 世纪 80 年代最后记录菠菜尖嘴鱼的研究人员之一。他证实了这一重新发现。 国际自然保护联盟海马、海龙和海马专家组主席、海洋生物学家阿曼达·文森特 (Amanda Vincent) 表示：“听到菠菜海龙鱼被重新记录下来，我的心在歌唱。” “了解到菠菜尖嘴鱼仍然存在，让我们希望其他‘消失’的物种也在那里。” 菠菜尖嘴鱼被英国保护组织 SHOAL 评为 10 种“最想要”消失的淡水鱼类之一。该组织表示，它的重新发现凸显了保护淡水鱼的紧迫性。 在整个探险过程中的采访中，村民们报告说，由于采矿、伐木和其他威胁，本地鱼类数量减少。在全球范围内，淡水鱼面临着越来越大的压力。联合国最近的一份报告发现，在过去的半个世纪里，洄游淡水鱼的数量减少了 81%。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. Proverbs 2:6 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with humble learning and wise application, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到智慧、知识与追求真理。Proverbs 2:6提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以谦卑学习与智慧运用来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: Rising CO2 Speeds the Growth of Grasses on the African Savanna
title.zh: 二氧化碳浓度上升加速了非洲稀树草原上的草的生长

summary.en: On the arid African savanna, grasses are growing faster than they were a generation ago, boosted by rising levels of carbon dioxide from the burning of fossil fuels. That is the finding of a new study that warns that faster growth could fuel larger wildfires and alter the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On the arid African savanna, grasses are growing faster than they were a generation ago, boosted by rising levels of carbon dioxide from the burning of fossil fuels. That is the finding of a new study that warns that faster growth could fuel larger wildfires and alter the distribution of wildlife.

Since the dawn of the industrial age, the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere has grown by half, which is helping to speed photosynthesis and cause many plants to grow faster. The phenomenon, known as “carbon fertilization,” has been well documented in forests , and some experts believe it may be responsible for the greening of drylands around the globe.

It was long assumed, however, that grasses on the African savanna gain little from the extra carbon dioxide, as they already employ a highly efficient form of photosynthesis. But researchers are now finding otherwise. An analysis of three decades of data gathered from experiments and observations across Kruger National Park in South Africa shows that rising carbon dioxide levels are prompting faster growth.

Between 1989 and 2021, grass production rose by 28 percent, a shift that could not be explained by changes in rainfall, temperature, grazing, fire, or other drivers, according to the study , which was published in Nature . Researchers say that extra carbon dioxide is allowing grasses to use water more efficiently, which is helping them to grow more quickly, even through dry spells. Modeling suggests that savanna grasses will continue to benefit from the surplus carbon dioxide even as warming intensifies heat and drought.

The faster growth brings new risks, however. Researchers say more grass means more fuel for wildfires. It also means more forage, which could boost the number of grazing animals. And there is no guarantee that the additional carbon drawn down by grasses will stay locked away.

“The wider impact depends on where the extra grass ends up,” said lead author Kimberley Simpson, an ecologist at the University of Sheffield. “If it is eaten by animals or burned in fires, much of the carbon is quickly released back into the atmosphere.”
body.zh: 在干旱的非洲大草原上，由于化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳含量不断上升，草类的生长速度比上一代人更快。这是一项新研究的发现，该研究警告说，更快的生长可能会引发更大的野火并改变野生动物的分布。 自工业时代到来以来，大气中的二氧化碳含量增加了一半，这有助于加速光合作用，使许多植物生长得更快。这种被称为“碳施肥”的现象在森林中已有详细记录，一些专家认为它可能是全球旱地绿化的原因。 然而，长期以来人们一直认为非洲大草原上的草从额外的二氧化碳中获得的很少，因为它们已经采用了高效的光合作用形式。但研究人员现在发现并非如此。对南非克鲁格国家公园三十年来的实验和观察收集的数据的分析表明，二氧化碳水平的上升正在促进更快的生长。 根据发表在《自然》杂志上的这项研究，1989 年至 2021 年间，草产量增加了 28%，这一变化无法用降雨、温度、放牧、火灾或其他驱动因素的变化来解释。研究人员表示，额外的二氧化碳可以让草更有效地利用水，从而帮助它们生长得更快，即使在干旱时期也是如此。模型表明，即使气候变暖加剧了炎热和干旱，稀树草原草仍将继续受益于过剩的二氧化碳。 然而，更快的增长带来了新的风险。研究人员表示，更多的草意味着更多的野火燃料。这也意味着更多的草料，这可能会增加食草动物的数量。并且不能保证草吸收的额外碳会被锁住。 “更广泛的影响取决于多余的草最终去了哪里，”谢菲尔德大学生态学家金伯利·辛普森说。 “如果它被动物吃掉或在火中燃烧，大部分碳会很快释放回大气中。”

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Filipino Cacao Growers Learn to Live With a Hotter Climate
title.zh: 菲律宾可可种植者学会与更炎热的气候共存

summary.en: The film "Chocolates Melting Away" documents how cacao farmers in the Philippines are developing new methods to safeguard their crops against increasingly erratic weather patterns, such as drought, floods, and extreme heat, which pose significant challenges to the region's multi-million dollar cacao industry.
summary.zh: 电影《融化的巧克力》记录了菲律宾的可可种植者如何开发新技术来保护他们的作物免受日益不稳定的天气模式的影响，例如干旱、洪水和极端高温，这些都对该地区价值数亿美元的可可产业构成了严峻挑战。

body.en:
In “Chocolates Melting Away” — the First-Place Winner of the 2026 Yale Environment 360 Film Contest — Breech Asher Harani explores how cacao growers in the Philippines are developing new techniques to protect their crops from increasingly turbulent weather.

In the Philippines, ideal growing conditions for cacao have fueled an industry with a market value of more than $400 million. In the Davao region, on the island of Mindanao, growers tend trees, harvest fruits, and produce premium chocolates for the domestic market. But climate change, which has brought drought, floods, more humidity, and extreme heat to the region, has presented growers with serious challenges.

Based in Davao, filmmaker Breech Asher Harani set out to document the concerns of cacao farmers at two artisanal operations and speak with agricultural researchers about the industry’s efforts to adapt to changing conditions. Farmers demonstrated how they use intercropping, produce fertilizers from agricultural waste to increase yields and quality, and employ innovative irrigation systems to minimize water loss.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

“These farmers are very well versed when it comes to climate mitigation strategies and sustainable farming techniques,” Harani says, noting that he never sensed a feeling of hopelessness among growers. Not only do the cacao farmers seem “ready to face the battle,” Harani says, “they are also ready to show others what they are doing so their methods can be replicated.”

Harani hopes his film elevates the importance of farmers, “whose hard work sustains our everyday needs,” and that viewers will feel motivated to take action against climate change, “which is already reshaping what we eat.”

About the Filmmaker: Breech Asher Harani is a filmmaker and artist whose work spans narrative, documentary, experimental, and animated forms. In 2019, he was named a JCS International Young Creatives awardee at the International Emmy Awards, and was subsequently listed on Forbes Asia’s 30 Under 30 for the Arts. Harani is the first recipient of a Climate and Labor Film Grant, awarded jointly by the Pulitzer Center, the Financial Times , and One World Media.

About the Contest: Now in its 13th season, the Yale Environment 360 Film Contest honors the year’s best environmental documentary shorts from around the world. This year we received 596 submissions from more than 80 countries across six continents, with the winners selected by the editors of Yale Environment 360 .
body.zh: 在 2026 年耶鲁环境 360 度电影大赛一等奖《巧克力融化》中，Breech Asher Harani 探讨了菲律宾的可可种植者如何开发新技术来保护作物免受日益动荡的天气影响。 在菲律宾，理想的可可生长条件催生了一个市场价值超过 4 亿美元的产业。在棉兰老岛的达沃地区，种植者照料树木、收获水果，并为国内市场生产优质巧克力。但气候变化给该地区带来了干旱、洪水、湿度增加和极端高温，给种植者带来了严峻的挑战。 总部位于达沃的电影制作人布里奇·阿舍·哈拉尼 (Breech Asher Harani) 着手记录两个手工作业中可可种植者的担忧，并与农业研究人员讨论该行业为适应不断变化的条件所做的努力。农民们展示了如何利用间作、利用农业废弃物生产肥料来提高产量和质量，以及如何采用创新的灌溉系统来最大限度地减少水的流失。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 哈拉尼说：“这些农民非常精通气候缓解策略和可持续农业技术。”他指出，他从未在种植者中感受到绝望的感觉。哈拉尼说，可可种植者似乎不仅“准备好面对这场战斗”，“他们还准备向其他人展示他们正在做的事情，以便他们的方法可以被复制。” 哈拉尼希望他的电影能够提升农民的重要性，“他们的辛勤工作维持着我们的日常需求”，并且观众会感到有动力采取行动应对气候变化，“这已经在重塑我们的饮食。” 关于电影制片人：布里奇·阿舍·哈拉尼 (Breech Asher Harani) 是一位电影制片人和艺术家，其作品涵盖叙事、纪录片、实验和动画形式。 2019年，他被评为国际艾美奖JCS国际青年创意奖获得者，随后入选福布斯亚洲30位30岁以下艺术精英。哈拉尼是第一位获得气候与劳工电影奖的获奖者，该奖由普利策中心、英国《金融时报》和同一个世界媒体联合颁发。 关于大赛：耶鲁环境 360 度电影大赛现已进入第 13 季，旨在表彰来自世界各地的年度最佳环境纪录片短片。今年，我们收到了来自六大洲 80 多个国家的 596 份参赛作品，获奖者由耶鲁环境 360 的编辑选出。

reflection.en: As climate change brings more extreme weather, farmers in the Philippines are innovating to protect their cacao crops. This story calls to mind the Genesis mandate to tend and care for the Earth, recognizing its bounty as a gift to be stewarded responsibly. May we, like these farmers, seek wisdom and resilience in adapting to environmental challenges,...
reflection.zh: 随着气候变化带来更极端的天气，菲律宾的农民正在创新以保护他们的可可作物。这个故事让人想起《创世记》中关于照管和照料大地的使命，认识到大地的丰饶是需要负责任地管理的恩赐。 愿我们像这些农民一样，在适应环境挑战中寻求智慧和韧性，荣耀那托付给我们的创造物。

title.en: ‘Environmental violence’: inside the fight to save indigenous land from becoming a nuclear dumping ground
title.zh: “环境暴力”：在保护原住民土地免遭核废料倾倒的斗争中

summary.en: The new documentary 'To Use a Mountain' showcases the struggles and successes of indigenous communities resisting government plans to designate parts of the rural US as nuclear waste disposal sites. The film touches upon the complex history of nuclear energy, initially presented as a solution but fraught with safety...
summary.zh: 新纪录片《使用一座山》展示了原住民社区在抵制政府将美国乡村部分地区指定为核废料处理场计划中所经历的斗争和取得的成功。该片触及了核能复杂的历史，它最初被誉为解决方案，但却伴随着安全隐患和环境影响。

body.en: New documentary To Use a Mountain spotlights the pain and triumph of resisting government efforts to turn parts of rural US into disposal sites Nuclear energy was supposed to be our salvation, humanity’s chance to retool technology first conceived as a weapon of mass destruction into an engine of limitless prosperity. But even as the industry touted nuclear fission as an economic game-changer (never mind the astronomical startup costs ), a safety paragon (never mind the spills at Chornobyl , Three Mile Island and Fukushima ) and harmless fodder for an American comedy institution (never mind that glowing rod on Homer’s back or the three-eyed fish), there was no getting around the matter of what to do with all the toxic waste (never mind nuclear’s claimed green credentials). The stagnant state of that dirty business brought Casey Carter, the director of the new avant-garde documentary called To Use a Mountain , back to his interview with a Washington state farmer who was part of a class-action lawsuit against the government over the release of radioactive material from the Hanford nuclear reservation – site of the world’s first full-scale plutonium production reactor. The farmer’s words still echo, despite ultimately being cut to fit the film’s 90-minute runtime. “He joked that nuclear power is the only faith-based energy because everyone always asks, ‘Do you believe in it?’” Carter says. “He was like, ‘You don’t have to believe in solar. It’s just a pretty good idea.’” Continue reading...
body.zh: 新纪录片《利用一座山》聚焦了抵制政府将美国部分农村地区变成处置场的努力的痛苦和胜利。核能被认为是我们的救赎，人类有机会将最初被设想为大规模杀伤性武器的技术改造为无限繁荣的引擎。但是，尽管该行业将核裂变吹捧为经济游戏规则的改变者（更不用说天文数字的启动成本）、安全典范（更不用说切尔诺贝利、三哩岛和福岛的泄漏事件）和美国喜剧机构的无害素材（更不用说荷马背上的发光棒或三眼鱼），但仍然无法回避如何处理所有有毒废物的问题（更不用说核能声称绿色凭证）。这一肮脏行业的停滞状态让新前卫纪录片《利用一座山》的导演凯西·卡特回想起他对一位华盛顿州农民的采访，这位农民正参与针对政府的集体诉讼，该诉讼涉及汉福德核保护区（世界上第一个全面的钚生产反应堆所在地）释放放射性物质。尽管最终为了适应影片 90 分钟的时长而进行了剪辑，但这位农民的话仍然令人回响。 “他开玩笑说核能是唯一基于信仰的能源，因为每个人总是问，‘你相信它吗？’”卡特说。 “他说，‘你不必相信太阳能。这只是一个很好的主意。’”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary 'To Use a Mountain' brings to light the profound challenges faced by indigenous communities fighting to protect their ancestral lands from becoming nuclear dumping grounds. Their struggle is a powerful testament to the need to advocate for the voiceless and defend the vulnerable against potentially devastating environmental decisions. It...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《使用一座山》揭示了原住民社区在为保护其祖传土地免遭核废料倾倒而进行的斗争中所面临的严峻挑战。他们的抗争有力地证明了为那些不能为自己发声的人代言，并为了子孙后代和地球本身的利益，挺身而出对抗可能带来毁灭性环境决策的必要性。它促使我们思考，进步的代价由谁承担，以及为未来世代和地球本身发声的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

Sumerian Pictures has acquired North American rights to “ Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt ,” a salute to the trailblazing American rock band, The Butthole Surfers.

The film is directed by Tom Stern and combines archival footage, animation, puppetry, and reenactments featuring the band. In addition, Richard Linklater, Flea, Dave Grohl, John Paul Jones, Henry Rollins, and Ice-T are interviewed about a group that was known for combining psychedelia, punk and grunge with energetic, anti-establishment, often chaotic live shows.

“Tom Stern and team are taking us on a wild ride and we are excited to bring audiences to the incredible story of these punk icons,” Rob Williams, president of Sumerian Pictures, said. Related Stories New York City’s East Side Will Lose Yet Another Movie Theater with Imminent Closure of AMC Kips Bay Indie Star Joe Swanberg Never Really Left — but He’s Definitely Back Now

Sumerian is a newcomer to the indie distribution scene , but it turned heads with its acquisition of the 2026 Sundance Grand Jury Prize and Audience Award winner, “Josephine,” starring Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan. The film is seen as a potential awards season player .

Though it only got into the film business last year, its parent company Sumerian has been in the music and publishing game for 20 years. Recent and upcoming Sumerian Pictures films include Louis Paxton’s comedy, “The Incomer”; the romantic comedy “Mile End Kicks,” directed by Chandler Levack; and “Horsegirls,” directed by Lauren Meyering.

“The Butthole Surfers are one of the most mind-blowing stories in rock history. Our goal was to make a film that captured their essence, so the ecstatic reactions of film festival audiences have been deeply gratifying,” Stern said. “I’m thrilled Sumerian has joined forces with us to bring this experience to an ever wider audience.”

Williams negotiated the deal on behalf of Sumerian with Dan Braun and Matt Burke from Submarine. Winner of the SXSW “Best in Texas” award, the documentary audience award at the Philadelphia Film Festival, and the grand jury prize for best documentary at the Independent Film Festival Boston, “Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt” has been entertaining audiences at festivals around the country prior to its theatrical release this week as part of exclusive event engagements at Drafthouse Cinema....

reflection.en: The news of a documentary about "The Butthole Surfers" receiving an award and distribution rights invites us to consider the cultural content we embrace. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to fix our thoughts on whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and admirable. As we engage with various forms of art and media, this verse offers a timeless guide for...
reflection.zh: 关于纪录片《Butthole Surfers》获奖并获得发行权的消息，促使我们思考我们所接纳的文化内容。腓立比书4:8鼓励我们将思想专注于真实、高尚、公正、纯洁、可爱和值得称赞的事物。当我们接触各种形式的艺术和媒体时，这节经文为我们提供了永恒的辨别指南，促使我们反思什么能真正丰富我们的思想和精神。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Guardian-produced Gaza documentary from Oscar-winning Israeli directors of No Other Land to screen at Venice film festival

summary.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham...
summary.zh: 由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔（与巴塞尔·阿德拉和哈姆丹·巴拉尔共同执导《无他之地》）执导的《卫报》制作的加沙纪录片，将调查战争期间“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”，并将在威尼斯电影节首映。这部名为《NAZA》的电影由吉姆·威尔逊制作，乔纳森·格雷泽（《利益区域》团队）担任执行制片人，是今...

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary, "NAZA," premiering at the Venice Film Festival, seeks to bring to light the alleged "calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" in Gaza. In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
